jobs.title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
jobs.description:
Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant

Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite.

Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission.

  • Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance.
  • Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée.
  • Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses.
  • Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation.
  • Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être.

Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience :

  • Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes.
  • Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission.

Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons

Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté.

Ce que nous cherchons

  • Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes.
  • Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas.
  • La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise.
  • De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole.
  • Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients.
  • Français langue maternelle ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier.

Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps

  • Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris.
  • Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe.
  • Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client.

Ce que vous trouverez chez nous

  • Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME.
  • Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année.
  • Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet.
  • Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux.

Comment nous recrutons

Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape.

  • 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions.
  • 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter.
  • 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés.

Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape.

The Role

As part of the local Critical Operations Team, Critical Operations Technicians (COT) ensure the data center is operating smoothly and efficiently 24/7/365, with no downtime of critical services. Critical Operations Technicians are responsible for the inspection, operation and maintenance of all equipment associated with the data center. They are expected to be technically strong with great troubleshooting abilities and a desire to learn and work in a demanding yet rewarding team environment. The Critical Operations Team's on-site presence is organized in a 24/7 shift schedule, ensuring coverage at all hours of the day, year-round.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform operational, preventive, and corrective maintenance on all mechanical and electrical equipment as assigned.

  • Conduct daily and weekly routine inspections on critical equipment, rooms, and systems, ensuring compliance with quality and efficiency standards.

  • Monitor, respond to, and act on alarms from Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS), and other monitoring tools.

  • Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical systems, interpreting diagrams and schematics to detect, repair, and report faulty equipment or unusual conditions.

  • Carry out isolation and reinstatement of electrical, cooling, fire alarm, and gas suppression systems when required and authorized.

  • Manage and react to emergency situations involving critical equipment, escalating incidents according to established processes and procedures.

  • Ensure all plant equipment operates at maximum efficiency and in compliance with industry best practices and regulations.

  • Escort personnel when required for security or operational reasons (e.g. clients and vendors).

  • Ensure compliance with housekeeping rules, facility manuals, and service agreements, managing vendor reports and follow-ups.

  • Maintain accurate logs of completed and pending work in the Facility Management System.

  • Support the preparation of technical work quotations and execution of assigned projects and programs.

  • Maintain proper storage of documentation related to building infrastructure, systems, and tools.

  • Participate in ongoing training, development, and drills to stay updated in relevant disciplines.

  • Ensure a proper handover of relevant information within the team as needed.

 

Job Practicalities / Skills, Knowledge, Experience and Qualifications

  • Preferably in possession of trade certificate and/or vocational education degree within Electrical or Mechanical discipline or equivalent.

  • Preferably experienced with electrical or mechanical systems in a critical environment and/or within a data center.

  • In-depth knowledge of various maintenance fundamentals to deal with service and repairs.

  • Ability to perform a range of complex work activities with some degree of personal responsibility and autonomy.

  • Ability to work alone or collaboratively in a team.

  • Attention to detail while maintaining a broad perspective

  • Desire and ability to learn new skills and systems.

  • Effective interpersonal skills for collaboration with vendors and clients.

  • IT and computer skills (MS Office suite) with ability to work in and learn various operating software tools and systems.

  • Good written and verbal skills in English and local language (German/Scandinavian/French/Italian languages are a plus).

  • Service-oriented mindset with a focus on client satisfaction.

 

Preferred start date: November 2026. However, an earlier start date may be discussed and arranged depending on the candidate's availability.

 

All applications will be treated confidentially.

jobs.title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
jobs.description: Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire. Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.   Notre ambition est claire : Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux. Le projet :Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités : - Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun - Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes - Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations - Faire monter les équipes en compétence - Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal - Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ; - Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ; - Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier. Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.  La mission :- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc. - veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.    Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.  Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment : - Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Participer à la conception du Master Plan. Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer exigence réglementaire, expertise zoologique et intelligence collective. Vous devrez accompagner Sainte-Croix dans la nouvelle étape du pôle animalier : être une équipe exemplaire, structurée, responsable et pleinement alignée avec la raison d'être du parc. Vous devrez également :- être titulaire du Certificat de capacité adapté aux espèces concernées. - justifier d'une solide expérience en parc zoologique. - posséder un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Très bonne connaissance du bien-être animal, de la sécurité et des obligations réglementaires. - Capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec une direction, une responsable zoologique, des responsables de secteur et des équipes terrain. - Goût pour la transmission, la structuration et l'accompagnement du changement. - Capacité à déléguer et à faire grandir les équipes. - Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de conservation, d'éducation et de reconnexion au vivant. Vous ne serez pas seulement le garant d'un cadre, vous serez l'un des artisans d'une nouvelle organisation au service des animaux, des équipes et de la mission du parc.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control
jobs.description: Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control – ExpertIntegro Consulting | Automotive & Powertrain Development | SwedenHelp shape the future of sustainable powertrain technologyIntegro Consulting is seeking a highly experienced Senior Expert in Embedded Software Architecture and Spark-Ignited Internal Combustion Engine (SI ICE) Control for a consulting assignment with our client, Volvo Trucks.This is an opportunity to contribute to next-generation powertrain technologies, particularly hydrogen-powered combustion engines and alternative fuels for heavy-duty applications.Combining expertise in embedded software, model-based control, and engine management with technical leadership, you will help develop advanced control systems, automate engineering workflows, and explore the potential of physics-inspired AI and machine learning.About the assignmentYou will contribute to early-phase development and concept engineering within a multidisciplinary powertrain organisation. Your primary focus will be embedded software architecture and model-based control systems for spark-ignited engines, particularly hydrogen internal combustion engines (H2 ICE).You will work across engineering disciplines to develop robust, scalable control solutions while improving software development, testing, verification, and calibration through automation. You will also investigate how physics-inspired AI/ML can enhance modelling, diagnostics, control strategies, and engineering optimisation.Key responsibilities    Embedded software architecture: Define scalable architectures and control concepts for SI ICE applications, particularly hydrogen engines.        Engine control: Develop and integrate ECU functions for air-path management, torque modelling, combustion control, knock detection, and knock control.        Model-based development: Translate system requirements into control models, software implementations, and verified solutions.        Software integration: Integrate ECU functions with sensors, actuators, diagnostics, communication interfaces, and powertrain platforms.        Automation: Improve software development, code generation, continuous integration, testing, and verification workflows.        Calibration optimisation: Automate calibration processes, measurement-data analysis, test planning, and optimisation.        Physics-inspired AI/ML: Explore physics-based and data-driven methods for modelling, control, diagnostics, and optimisation.        Testing and verification: Support SIL/HIL testing, engine test-bench activities, calibration, and release-readiness assessments.        Technical leadership: Lead design reviews, coordinate engineering activities, provide technical recommendations, and share knowledge.Required qualifications and experienceWe are looking for a senior technical expert who can take ownership of complex engineering challenges and deliver high-quality solutions.You should have:    An M.Sc., PhD, or equivalent expertise in control engineering, mechatronics, electronics, automation, applied physics, mechanical engineering, or a related field.        Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in powertrain development, embedded systems, or automotive product development.        Extensive experience in model-based control for spark-ignited combustion engines, including requirements, modelling, implementation, integration, verification, and calibration.        Deep knowledge of ECU function development, air-path control, torque modelling, combustion control, and knock detection and control.        Strong experience in embedded software architecture, AUTOSAR Classic, software integration, diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols.        Knowledge of functional safety and cybersecurity, including ISO 26262 and SAE J21434.        Experience with SIL/HIL testing, engine test benches, data analysis, and technical documentation.        Practical experience in automated software development, code generation, scripting, continuous integration, and automated testing.        Experience in ECU calibration and optimisation, including test planning and measurement-data processing.        Advanced working knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink and Python.        Experience with ATI Vision and/or AVL Concerto. Knowledge of ETAS INCA, ETAS ASCMO, TargetLink, and C/C++ is also relevant.        Strong technical leadership, analytical skills, and the ability to communicate complex topics clearly in English.You are proactive, structured, and results-oriented, with the ability to challenge established approaches constructively and collaborate across engineering disciplines.Meritorious experienceThe following would be particularly valuable:    Development or calibration of hydrogen, natural gas, or other alternative-fuel SI engines, especially for heavy-duty applications.        Experience with physics-inspired AI/ML, physics-informed learning, hybrid modelling, virtual sensing, anomaly detection, or data-driven control.        Applying AI/ML to improve engineering workflows, software development, testing, or calibration.        Knowledge of software-defined vehicle architectures, AUTOSAR Adaptive, or RTOS-based solutions.        Experience in heavy-duty powertrain development, calibration, verification tools, or engineering methods.        Contributions to technical roadmaps, patents, scientific publications, or engineering competence development.Interested in this opportunity?If you have the expertise to advance embedded engine control and sustainable powertrain technology, we would like to hear from you.Please submit your CV and a brief summary of your relevant experience, highlighting your expertise in embedded software architecture, SI ICE control, model-based development, ECU calibration, and automation.Please also include your availability and any experience with hydrogen engines or physics-inspired AI/ML.Apply through Integro Consulting to discuss the assignment and how you can contribute to this exciting development programme.

jobs.title: Hepatologist
jobs.description: At Sahlgrenska University Hospital, we work together to provide the highest quality of care with the patient at the center. Our great commitment and continuous learning make us one of the country's leading university hospitals. We provide everything from county healthcare to national highly specialized care. We focus on the future of healthcare through exciting research. We care about digital skills and everyone's contribution to the digital development. Our work is about using our collected knowledge and experiences together with you – to create value for our patients.We are transforming healthcare with the ambition of becoming Europe’s leading university hospital by 2032. In partnership with our patients, we work to ensure quality, accessibility, patient safety, research, education, and innovation within an integrated healthcare system across the Västra Götaland Region in Sweden.Sahlgrenska University Hospital is one of Northern Europe's largest hospitals with over 17,000 colleagues who have different experience and backgrounds.About usThe Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Sahlgrenska University Hospital (SU) is one of the largest in the Nordic region. We provide emergency and scheduled outpatient care, and have close collaboration with other departments including upper and lower GI surgery, and transplantation surgery.The department is organized into teams focusing on hepatologic outpatient care, gastroenterologic outpatient care, endoscopy, intestinal failure unit, and an inpatient ward. The department is actively involved in ongoing research across several fields and has a strong emphasis on education, continuing professional development, and the ongoing advancement of clinical services.What can we offer? As a Specialist Physician/Senior Consultant at the Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatolgy at Sahlgrenska university Hospital, you will have excellent opportunities for professional development and research. You will work within our subspecialty teams alongside ambitious and friendly colleagues, with close collaboration with the transplantation unit.The department has a high patient volume, providing extensive opportunities for both clinical practice and research.Our goal is to provide the highest possible standard of care for our patients. We place great importance on supporting each individual's professional development according to their interests, strengths, and career goals, while also enabling them to influence their working environment.About the RoleYou will work with the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients requiring specialized care in hepatology in both emergency and elective settings. Your duties will include working in the outpatient clinic, inpatient ward, and at the liver transplant unit, as well as participation during office hours and on-call duties.Teaching and supervising less experienced colleagues, medical students, and healthcare professionals is an integral part of the role. You will also be expected to take an active part in the department’s quality improvement, development, and change initiatives, as well as in research activities.About YouWe are looking for a board-certified senior consultant in Gastroenterology and Hepatology with a high level of expertise in hepatology. You should be interested in both your own professional development and contributing to the advancement of care at one of the largest university hospitals in the Nordic region. You work well within a team and have a strong interest in liver disease.We value strong communication and collaboration skills. You are able to apply newly acquired knowledge in your clinical practice, make sound clinical judgments, and thrive in a fast-paced work environment. We are seeking a motivated and independent individual with the ability and interest to take overall responsibility and place the patient's needs at the center of care.Ongoing research activities and/or a doctoral degree (PhD) are considered meritorious.Great emphasis will be placed on personal suitability.Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis throughout the recruitment period.We warmly welcome your application!Together for the patient - Sahlgrenska UniversitetssjukhusetIn the event of recruiting a physician or nurse with a foreign medical license and/or specialist certification, the appointment will be preceded by the necessary process to fulfill the requirements for Swedish licensure and/or specialist recognition.About Region Västra GötalandRegion Västra Götaland is there for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure good quality healthcare for everyone. We work towards a sustainable development and growth, a clean environment, an improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland.Region Västra Götaland is actively working to digitize more ways of working. To be part of the digital transformation, you need to have basic skills and be able to use digital tools and services. You know how to search for information, how to communicate and interact digitally, you are also risk-aware and motivated to be part of the development to learn new things.If you want to know more about Region Västra Götaland, you can visit our introduction to new employees at www.vgregion.se/introduction.  You can also read more in the presentation on Salary, remuneration and benefits – what you will receive as an employee in VGR.All permanent employees of Region Västra Götaland are assigned wartime postings.ApplicationRegion Västra Götaland would like you to register your application through the recruitment system. jobs.description: Company description:Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves   You’ll join the Leader and Employee Communication team, part of the broader Communication and Public Affairs organisation. Together, we help leaders communicate with clarity and purpose, while ensuring employees feel informed, engaged and connected to Volvo Cars’ strategic direction.   Working closely with communication colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation, we translate business priorities into clear, relevant and engaging communication, delivered through the right messages and channels.   We are a collaborative and creative team that values fresh thinking, strong relationships and communication that makes a meaningful difference. We encourage curiosity, bold ideas and new ways of working, and foster an international culture where people are united by a shared purpose.     What you'll do   You will create communications content and execute communication strategies in line with established communication policies. You will follow communication plans and share company information through a combination of channels.    People who make a difference are the driving force that has built one of the most recognisable brands in the world. We are looking for change makers who think about communication opportunities in exciting and different ways, creative and critical thinkers who want to make a difference with us at Volvo Cars. In this role, you will:      Shape the news and information flow within Volvo Cars, driving employee engagement and strategic alignment and encouraging employees to become proactive brand ambassadors.     Develop multi-channel communication strategies around news-based stories and see them through to execution.     Develop thought-leadership positions that strengthen employee engagement and the Volvo Cars brand.     Drive the development and consistent implementation of stories and messages that support our corporate strategy and core values across communication channels globally.     Collaborate with business area communication teams to identify and develop relevant news-based stories from across the company.     Co-create the editorial calendar across communication channels.     Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and provide high-level communication guidance.     Contribute to developing our employee communication capabilities by keeping up with trends and best practices from other industries and implementing working methods and tools that strengthen employee engagement.      What you'll bring   We are looking for a social, passionate and creative communications professional with experience in developing and delivering engaging and motivating communication strategies. You have deep experience in earned communication and/or journalism and the ability to utilise different channels to support desired business outcomes. You thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment and are comfortable adapting to changing business priorities. You combine your natural interest in creating innovative communication with an ability to identify the right channel for different stories.         BA / BSc in communication, journalism or equivalent experience     A strategic and creative approach to communication planning, with an ability to manage a range of projects, balancing quality and speed     Exceptional communication skills and fluency in English and Chinese, both verbal and written      Experience working across different communication channels and formats.     Strong ability to build good working relationships with stakeholders and internal colleagues.     Experience in journalism, earned communication or corporate communication.     Experience from the automotive industry and/or financial communication is considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Psychologist
jobs.description: Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.Role SummaryScania Occupational Health Services Sweden is looking for an experienced licensed psychologist who would like to provide qualified support to Scania’s operations in Södertälje. In this role, you will work with issues relating to individuals’ health and circumstances, group interaction and development, and organizational ways of working and change. You will support employees, managers, HR and management teams, adapting your interventions to their needs—from clinical support for individuals to consultative work with groups and organizations.You will contribute psychological expertise and a holistic perspective to issues relating to work-related ill health, rehabilitation, collaboration, conflict and change. The aim is to promote health and create sustainable conditions for both people and the business.You will be part of a cross-professional team in a global and dynamic organization. Your experience and ability to translate knowledge into practical support will be important to our work to promote health, safety and sustainable productivity.  Job ResponsibilitiesYou will be part of a cross-functional team that includes occupational health physicians, occupational health nurses and other psychologists. In your customer team, you will also work with ergonomists and work environment engineers. You will work in a consultative capacity, supporting individuals, groups, managers, HR and management teams.The work includes both preventive and remedial interventions at individual, group and organizational levels. You will move between these levels according to the needs of each assignment and consider how individuals’ situations, group interactions and organizational conditions affect one another.Your main responsibilities will be to:    Conduct clinical assessments and provide time-limited psychological treatment for individuals, both individually and in groups, as well as support in cases of work-related ill health and rehabilitation.    Support individuals and groups with issues relating to health, work capacity, collaboration and return to work.    Support groups with group development, collaboration and conflict issues, for example through facilitation and consultative support.    Support managers, HR and management teams with issues relating to employee health, group interactions and organizational conditions.    Contribute psychological expertise to organizational changes and change management, focusing on how changes affect individuals, groups, leadership and the work environment.    Analyze organizational conditions and provide recommendations for sustainable ways of working and a good organizational and social work environment.    Develop and deliver training in areas such as mental health, change, work environment and leadership.The position is based at Occupational Health Services in Södertälje. When the customer assignment allows, the work can be carried out remotely.Who You Are    Licensed Psychologist with experience providing psychological support to individuals and groups.    Strong consultative background, partnering with managers, teams, and organizations to address workplace challenges and promote wellbeing.    Experience supporting organizational change, including reorganizations, new ways of working, and business transformations.    Knowledge of group dynamics, organizational psychology, and evidence-based interventions that support healthy and effective workplaces.    Experience working with work-related ill health, rehabilitation processes, and employee support.    Skilled in supporting managers and teams through collaboration, communication, and conflict-resolution challenges.    Able to build trust, provide constructive challenge, and translate psychological expertise into practical recommendations and actions.    Structured, empathetic, and adaptable, with excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken; experience within Occupational Health Services is considered an advantage.This Is UsOccupational Health Services Sweden is part of Global SHE, which supports Scania in the areas of safety, health and work environment. We are based in Södertälje, Oskarshamn and Luleå in Sweden, as well as at other locations around the world. Our role as an independent expert resource is to guide Scania in its work to ensure and promote health, safety and sustainable productivity. Our work is based on legislation, science and proven experience. We also have a preventive and methods-development remit, aimed at supporting Scania in complying with legislation. As an integrated part of the business, we have a good understanding of the workplaces and the opportunity to follow operations over time.Scania OffersWe offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.ApplicationWe look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-10. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

jobs.title: International Advocacy Advisor
jobs.description: RFSL is seeking an International Advocacy Advisor to support Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists in advancing their advocacy priorities and influencing policy at national, regional and international levels. The role combines international advocacy, partnership development and capacity strengthening, with practical programme and administrative support that enables locally led movements to thrive.About RFSL and our international workRFSL (the Swedish Federation for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer, and Intersex Rights), founded in 1950, is one of the world’s oldest non-profit organisations working to advance LGBTQI rights.RFSL’s international work supports LGBTQI movements in Eastern Europe, Asia and Africa through regranting, partnerships, knowledge exchange, organisational support and advocacy. We work closely with local partners to support locally led movements, strengthen their agency and influence, and contribute to enabling environments for LGBTQI rights at national, regional and global levels.Your role with usYou will work closely with Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists to strengthen their ability to lead and influence advocacy processes. Together with partners, you will identify priorities, develop strategies and messaging, map stakeholders, and find opportunities to engage decision-makers and relevant international platforms, including the EU, UN, OSCE and Council of Europe.A central part of the role is helping partners access the knowledge, networks, resources and practical support they need to pursue their priorities. This includes organising capacity-strengthening activities, managing scholarships and providing hands-on programme and administrative support. You will also contribute to advocacy efforts in Sweden related to Ukraine and work with RFSL colleagues to align policy, advocacy and communications.You will collaborate with the Head of Program, International Program Managers, other Advocacy Advisors and colleagues across RFSL’s international work. The position is based in Stockholm and involves international travel several times per year.For full description of  key responsibilities and desirable qualifications, please see our job ad on RFSL’s careers pageWho are you?You are a structured, collaborative and solution-oriented professional committed to LGBTQI rights, international advocacy and locally led movement strengthening. You understand Ukraine’s political and social context, the regional human rights and civil society landscape, and the challenges facing LGBTQI organisations working in politically sensitive or resource-constrained environments.You build trusted partnerships and adapt your approach to different organisations, particularly grassroots groups that may need substantial practical support alongside strategic guidance. You respect local leadership and autonomy, understand power dynamics in international partnerships, and approach your work with awareness of security, safeguarding and the importance of accountable support.You enjoy combining strategic advocacy and capacity strengthening with practical operational and administrative tasks. You are comfortable moving between developing advocacy strategies and organising activities, coordinating travel, booking accommodation, handling receipts and ensuring that payments and documentation are in order. You recognise that this hands-on support is an important part of enabling partners to advance their own priorities.You bring strong analytical, communication and organisational skills, can represent RFSL professionally with civil society, public authorities and international institutions, and work effectively across teams and cultures. You are proactive, flexible and accountable, and share RFSL’s values of anti-racism, feminism, accessibility and intersectionality.To succeed in this role, you need:    A strong commitment to LGBTQI rights and experience or demonstrated competence in advocacy, policy influence, civil society support or related human rights work, particularly in relation to Ukraine.    Strong knowledge of the human rights situation and civil society landscape in Ukraine or the wider region, including experience working in partnership with LGBTQI movements or organisations.    At least three years of relevant professional experience in advocacy, civil society support, development cooperation or a related field.    Experience engaging with international or regional advocacy processes and human rights mechanisms, such as those of the EU, UN, OSCE or Council of Europe.    An understanding of security and safeguarding considerations when working with LGBTQI activists and civil society in challenging contexts.    Strong analytical, organisational and administrative skills, including experience with organisational capacity assessment, budgets, programme documentation and risk management.    Excellent written and spoken English.    Some understanding of Ukrainian or a closely related language, together with a willingness to develop Ukrainian-language skills as needed.    The ability to work from Stockholm, Sweden, and undertake international travel several times per year.Employment terms    Employment type: This is a permanent position, starting with a six-month probationary period.     Location: RFSL office in Stockholm.    Start date: As agreed    Contract terms: Covered by the Collective Agreement for Nonprofit OrganizationsOur offerRFSL offers an inclusive, values-driven workplace where you can contribute to meaningful change alongside committed colleagues and partners. We provide competitive employment conditions, including occupational pension and parental benefits.How to applyApply by November 15th, 2026. The recruitment process is conducted in English and includes anonymous, competency-based assessment, a work-related assignment and a background check.For questions about the position or recruitment process, contact HR Partner Tobias Jensen at tobias.jensen@rfsl.se.RFSL strives to be an inclusive, feminist and anti-racist workplace. We welcome applicants regardless of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, sex characteristics, religion, race, ethnicity, country of origin, disability, age or other grounds of discrimination. We strongly encourage candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
jobs.description: What we do at BlykallaBlykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry, pioneering the development of small modular reactors that provide clean, safe, and reliable energy. Thanks to lead-cooling, we achieve high safety in a very compact format, allowing for a simple and cost-effective design that can be mass-produced. Our unique reactor design will provide safe and green baseload energy that perfectly complements solar and wind power.What you’ll get to doWe are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer with deep expertise in ABB 800xA DCS to lead the development of Blykalla's plant control system architecture and implementation strategy.This is a unique opportunity to help define the control philosophy of a first-of-a-kind advanced nuclear reactor. You will play a key role in ensuring that Blykalla develops and retains ownership of critical control system intellectual property while working closely with ABB and other suppliers.Key ResponsibilitiesDCS Architecture & Ownership    Lead the design and development of Blykalla's plant-wide automation and control system architecture.    Define the ABB 800xA system architecture for reactor, balance-of-plant, auxiliary, and test facility applications.    Develop internal engineering standards, libraries, templates, and control strategies to maximize in-house ownership of intellectual property.    Establish long-term governance for control system design, lifecycle management, cybersecurity, and configuration control.Control System Engineering    Develop functional specifications, control narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, and automation philosophies.    Design and implement control logic, sequences, interlocks, alarms, and operator interfaces.    Configure ABB 800xA applications, controllers, engineering environments, and HMI systems.    Define communication architectures including OPC UA, IEC 61850, Modbus, Profibus/Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and other industrial protocols.    Develop and maintain simulation and testing environments for control system validation.Nuclear Plant Integration    Support the integration of reactor systems, safety systems, and balance-of-plant equipment into the overall control architecture.    Work closely with reactor, thermal-hydraulic, electrical, mechanical, and safety engineers to define system requirements.    Contribute to licensing and regulatory documentation related to instrumentation and control systems.    Support development of digital I&C architectures aligned with nuclear industry expectations and international standards.Vendor & Stakeholder Management    Act as the primary technical interface with ABB regarding 800xA architecture, licensing, engineering tools, and implementation support.    Ensure that Blykalla retains ownership of application software, engineering databases, configuration standards, and control strategies.    Manage external engineering partners and system integrators where required.    Participate in factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities.Verification & Validation    Develop testing methodologies for control logic verification and system validation.    Lead integration testing and commissioning activities.    Support development of digital twins and operator training simulators.    Ensure traceability from requirements through implementation and testing.Who you’ll get to work withThe Senior Control Systems Engineer sits in the Plant engineering Team within Blykalla. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla. Who you areYou will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:    MSc or BSc in Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, or related discipline.    Minimum 10 years of experience in industrial automation and control systems engineering.    Extensive hands-on experience with ABB 800xA DCS engineering, configuration, commissioning, and lifecycle management.    Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale DCS architectures.    Experience developing control strategies for complex industrial facilities.    Strong understanding of industrial networks, field instrumentation, and process control.    Fluent in English, spoken and written    Fluency in Swedish is a plusTechnical Skills    Expert-level knowledge of ABB 800xA:    AC 800M controllers    Control Builder    Aspect Objects    System 800xA Engineering    Operator Workplace    Alarm Management    Batch and Advanced Process Control (desirable)    Strong understanding of:    ISA-88    ISA-95    IEC 61511    IEC 61508    Industrial cybersecurity principles    Configuration management and software lifecycle practices    Experience with simulation and testing environments.Location This position is for our office in Stockholm.Reference & Background ChecksAs part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.We do not accept applications via email. We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies. Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

jobs.title: In-Room Dining and Breakfast Associate - Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description: Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners, Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.   We are now seeking a service-oriented In-Room Dining & Breakfast Associate to join our Food & Beverage team and contribute to delivering exceptional dining experiences for our guests. The primary focus of this role is providing attentive, efficient, and personalized room service, with additional responsibilities supporting breakfast and lunch service. For this role, we are looking for someone who is reliable, guest-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced hotel environment. You take pride in creating memorable guest experiences, enjoy working both independently and as part of a team, and are motivated by providing attentive, high-quality service that exceeds guest expectations. As an In-Room Dining & Breakfast Associate, you will play an important role in ensuring guests enjoy a seamless dining experience in the comfort of their rooms. From handling orders and delivering food and beverages to providing friendly and professional breakfast service, you will help uphold the hotel's standards of quality and hospitality. Main responsibilities:    Handle in-room dining orders, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and a high level of personalized guest service.    Deliver food and beverages to guest rooms promptly and professionally, ensuring an excellent presentation and overall dining experience.    Set up trays and trolleys according to hotel standards, ensuring all orders are complete and presented to a high standard.    Respond to guest requests, dietary requirements, and special preferences with care and attention to detail.    Coordinate closely with the kitchen and Food & Beverage team to ensure timely order preparation and delivery.    Collect used trays, trolleys, and dining equipment from guest rooms and maintain cleanliness in designated areas.    Assist with breakfast service, welcoming guests, answering questions, and ensuring a smooth and enjoyable dining experience.    Maintain the breakfast buffet throughout service, ensuring food items are fresh, replenished, and attractively presented.    Prepare the restaurant for breakfast, including buffet setup, table arrangements, and organizing service stations.    Clear and reset tables efficiently while maintaining a clean and welcoming dining environment.    Assist guests with dietary needs, ingredient questions, and recommendations, and serve coffee, tea, and other beverages as required.    Support lunch service and the transition between service periods when needed.    Maintain hygiene, safety, and food-handling standards at all times. Qualifications:    Able to fluently communicate verbally in English. Fluency in Swedish is a plus.    Previous experience in hospitality or a hotel is an advantage but not required.    Positive attitude and genuine passion for providing excellent guest service.    Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.    Strong teamwork and communication skills.    Comfortable with physical work, including lifting and moving items.In addition:You are a reliable and service-oriented team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced, event-focused environment. What We Offer:    Part time positions following a 6-month probation period, in accordance with the HRF collective agreement.    Chance of being part of one of the biggest renovation and re-positioning projects in Stockholm’s hotel scene.    Great opportunities for career growth.    A dynamic and inclusive work environment.    Employee discounted rates at over 10 000 hotels worldwide. Does this position sound interesting and like a good fit for you? Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible. Join our team and play a key role in creating memorable experiences for our guests!About Sheraton Stockholm HotelThe Sheraton brand, established in 1937, has been synonymous with excellence in hospitality. The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, opened in 1971 as the first international 5 star hotel in Stockholm, and it’s an icon in Sweden’s capital city. As part of Marriott International, Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is providing guests with thoughtful amenities, contemporary accommodation, and the best city center location. Our commitment to sustainability aligns with our owner Archer Hotel Managements ethos, making us a unique choice for conscientious travelers.Redefining the Essence of HospitalityWe are at the end of our renovation journey at Sheraton Stockholm. jobs.title: Comissioning & Warranty Lead
jobs.description: The final phase of a delivery is where our technology truly proves itself. Installation at the shipyard, commissioning, HAT and SAT, final acceptance, and the warranty period are critical stages in ensuring that the vessel performs as promised. They are also the moments that shape the customer’s lasting impression of our delivery.To strengthen our focus on this critical phase, we are now establishing a new Commissioning & Warranty function and are looking for two individuals to join the team who want to help shape it from the start. In this role, you will take operational responsibility for the delivery through its most decisive stage, where engineering is transformed into real-world performance and customer value.What you will be doingAs Responsible for Commissioning & Warranty, you are operationally responsible for a delivery from formal project handover, after FAT and delivery of the equipment, until the customer is transferred to standard Aftermarket support. You will plan, coordinate, and drive the delivery forward through arrival inspection, installation support, commissioning, HAT and SAT, customer acceptance, the warranty period, and ultimately formal warranty closure. Your mission is clear: keep everything moving until we leave behind vessels that perform as promised and customers who trust us to deliver again.Throughout this journey, you will be the customer’s primary operational point of contact, providing continuity, direction, and clear ownership from one phase to the next. Internally, you will be the connecting force between our technical, operational, and supporting functions, bringing the right people together, aligning priorities, and ensuring that the delivery continues to move forward.In practice, you will:    Take over the delivery from the Project Manager and make sure nothing falls between the two of you: scope, open points, documentation and warranty terms.    Coordinate field service resources and spare parts, and collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), technical support and suppliers to secure competence and availability against plan;    Ensure arrival inspection at site is completed and drive transport damage and shortages to resolution.    Support installation towards the shipyard, then plan and run commissioning, HAT and SAT until acceptance is obtained.    Act as operational owner of warranty cases, from registration and technical assessment to liability determination and resolution, including claim handling and supplier recovery.    Handle customer disputes and negotiate practical, commercially sound settlements within your mandate.    Keep scope boundaries, documentation, cost exposure and status visible and feed lessons learned back into engineering, production and service.You work within a clear mandate. Decisions on prioritization, technical resolution paths, resourcing, warranty assessment and settlements within your delegated authority are yours to make. The Project Manager remains accountable for the overall project, and the genuinely large questions are escalated but you are expected to solve, not to forward.We think you should haveYou have led projects before and know what it takes to keep stakeholders aligned when schedules are under pressure. You are comfortable being the main point of contact for customers and enjoy balancing technical, commercial and operational perspectives to move a project forward.We believe you have several years of experience in project management, commissioning management, or aftermarket/service management, preferably within the marine, offshore, energy, or other capital equipment industries. You hold a technical degree or have gained equivalent knowledge through practical experience. You have worked closely with shipyards, customers and suppliers, handling deviations, claims and commercial discussions, and you possess a solid technical understanding that allows you to actively participate in discussions with engineers and service technicians, form your own view of technical challenges, and contribute to finding solutions.You are comfortable working across multiple IT systems simultaneously, such as ERP platforms, case and claim management systems, documentation tools and reporting solutions. You also have a good understanding of contracts, warranty terms and the commercial impact of technical decisions. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required, while Swedish is considered an advantage. The role also involves occasional travel to shipyards, vessels and customer sites as needed, although travel is not the primary focus of the position.Just as important as your experience is the way you work. You are structured and proactive, with a natural ability to bring tasks to completion rather than letting them drift. You remain calm and professional in challenging situations, focusing on finding solutions and building strong relationships. You communicate clearly with people from different cultures, backgrounds and levels of an organization, and you take ownership of your responsibilities without waiting to be directed.Why join us    A role with real influence. Commissioning and warranty is where our promises to the customer are tested. We are building a clearer, more structured and more customer-focused way of working around it and you will help us shape it. Your work strengthens the transition between New Sales, Project Management and the Aftermarket organization, with better quality, stronger documentation, reduced cost leakage and stronger customer relationships as the result.    A global and technologically advanced environment. World-leading products for vessel propulsion, experienced colleagues and international customers. You will work closely with Project Management, Technical Support, Field Service, Engineering, our Product Centers and the regional Global Customer Support organizations, and build a cross-functional network across the business that few other roles give you.    Breadth, and room to grow. Few positions combine technology, coordination, customer dialogue, business understanding and continuous improvement the way this one does. It sits in a stable global organization with a strong culture of innovation, and offers good development opportunities in whichever direction you want to take next.    We offer flexible working hours and the option to work remote or from home office.Security Clearance is required for this position.Kongsberg Maritime - a global leader in maritime technology.

jobs.title: Upper School Counsellor - Starting Academic Year 2027
jobs.description:
The International School of Bergen is seeking an experienced, compassionate, and highly skilled School Counsellor to join our vibrant IB World School in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

Application

We welcome applications from suitably qualified and experienced counsellors who are genuinely committed to relocating to Norway and becoming part of our school community.

Please submit the following documents by email with the subject line "US School Counsellor Application" to laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no:

  • A current CV.

  • A covering letter explaining your relevant counseling experience, qualifications, experience working with children and young people, and motivation for working at the International School of Bergen.

  • Contact details for two professional referees, including your current or most recent employer.

Important - Relocation to Norway

Please only apply if you are seriously considering relocating to Bergen, Norway.

Candidates who are currently living outside Norway should be prepared to relocate and meet the relevant Norwegian immigration, visa and work permit requirements, where applicable.

As part of the application process, candidates may be asked to provide information regarding their nationality/passport country and current country of residence so that the school can establish the appropriate immigration and work permit requirements.

This is an on-site based position in Bergen, Norway.

Safeguarding

The International School of Bergen is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.

All appointments must provide a police background check from your home country and any country you have resided in for 6+ months in the last 10 years. Police background checks must be no more than 3 months old and can be presented prior to appointment.

All staff are expected to uphold the school's safeguarding policies and Code of Conduct.

Previous applicants should reapply if you are still seriously interested in the position.

If you have any questions in regards to this position, please contact Peter Ledger, Director peter.ledger@isbergen.no or Laura McGuffie, HR and Finance Manager laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if a suitable candidate is identified, so early applications are encouraged.

Closing Date for applications is 27th November 2026

Arbeidsoppgaver

About the Role

The School Counsellor will provide proactive and responsive counselling services to students across the school while supporting the implementation of a whole-school wellbeing programme consistent with the philosophy of the International Baccalaureate.

The role includes:

  • Providing confidential individual and small-group counselling.

  • Supporting students with social, emotional, behavioural and mental health needs.

  • Delivering preventative wellbeing programmes and age-appropriate classroom guidance.

  • Promoting resilience, self-management, positive relationships and emotional wellbeing.

  • Working collaboratively with teachers to identify and support students requiring additional care.

  • Advising school leadership on student wellbeing, safeguarding and pastoral care.

  • Liaising effectively with parents and guardians to support student success.

  • Coordinating referrals to external professionals and Norwegian support services where appropriate.

  • Supporting crisis response and student reintegration following significant life events.

  • Maintaining accurate, confidential records in accordance with GDPR and Norwegian legislation.

  • Contributing to safeguarding procedures and child protection practices.

  • Supporting transitions between PYP and MYP where applicable), ensuring continuity of care.

  • Promoting inclusion, diversity, intercultural understanding and student voice.

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Essential

  • A recognised qualification in Counselling, School Psychology, Educational Psychology, Social Work or a related field.

  • Professional registration or eligibility for registration where applicable.

  • Experience working with children and adolescents in a school setting.

  • Strong understanding of child and adolescent development.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusting relationships with students, families and staff.

  • Commitment to safeguarding and child protection.

  • High levels of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality.

  • Excellent spoken and written English.

  • A genuine willingness and ability to relocate to Bergen, Norway.

Desirable

  • Previous experience within an IB World School.

  • Knowledge of the IB Learner Profile and IB Approaches to Learning (ATL).

  • Experience supporting internationally mobile or multilingual students.

  • Experience working within multicultural communities.

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed and restorative practices.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Compassionate and approachable.

  • Calm and solution-focused.

  • Collaborative and reflective.

  • Culturally responsive and internationally minded.

  • An excellent listener with sound professional judgement.

  • Passionate about student wellbeing and inclusion.

  • Committed to continuous professional learning.

  • Open to embracing life and work within an international school community in Norway.

Vi tilbyr

Why Join Us?

Our school offers:

  • A welcoming and diverse international community.

  • Students representing many nationalities and cultures.

  • A collaborative and supportive staff culture.

  • Commitment to ongoing professional development.

  • Competitive salary and pension.

  • The opportunity to live and work in one of the world's most beautiful and family-friendly countries.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

About Our School

ISB is a co-educational private day school which is authorised to deliver the International Baccalaureate PYP and MYP programmes. The school currently has approximately 250 students enrolled from more than 30 nations and is experiencing expanding enrolment. Classes are small with a maximum of 20 students in each instructional group.

Our school is committed to developing internationally minded young people who embody the attributes of the IB Learner Profile. We believe that student wellbeing is fundamental to learning, and we are looking for a counsellor who shares our commitment to nurturing the academic, social, emotional and personal development of every learner.

Working collaboratively with students, families, teachers and school leaders, the successful candidate will play a central role in promoting wellbeing, inclusion, safeguarding and positive mental health across the school community.

jobs.title: Master Thesis in Adaptive Architecture for Human-AI Annotation Systems
jobs.description: Company description:.Job description:    Thesis Scope & Problem Statement   This thesis project is intended for two Master's students working together. The central focus of this Master's thesis is to design, implement, and evaluate a confidence-aware adaptiverification architecture within the existing annotation tool. Instead of applying the same review process every detection or scene, the system will use confidence signals to select an appropriate depth of humverification. This is a software engineering thesis focused on how to structure, integrate, test, and evaluathat adaptive behavior, with particular attention to maintainability, traceability, fallback behavior, andeffective human oversight. Existing AI models provide the application context; developing new perceptimodels is not the primary objective. Research Objectives & Tasks   The work may include:      Design and integrate a modular architecture with explicit interfaces for confidence providerverification policies, decision logging, and annotator feedbac     Implement confidence-provider components that expose calibrated or normalized signals, such model confidence, model agreement, source model, and object class frequency, through a comminterface.     Implement and compare interchangeable threshold-based and learned decision policies for routingcases to light review, full review, or a second review. Automatic acceptance will be considered onlywhere permitted by safety policy, with low-confidence, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical casrouted to human review.     Integrate attention cues into the annotation interface and record the signals, policy version, selectedreview mode, and human outcome for each routing decision.     Develop automated tests for routing decisions, component interfaces, and fallback behavior.     Benchmark the adaptive architecture against existing manual, sequential, and parallel workflousing annotation correctness, recall on safety-critical classes, error catch rates, task completion time,routing overhead, and human intervention.     Evaluate maintainability and testability through change scenarios, such as adding a confidenprovider or replacing a decision policy.     Conduct a counterbalanced user study to investigate verification behavior, cognitive workload, trucalibration, and susceptibility to automation bias.  Depending on feasibility and measurable added value, the work may also explore out-of-distributiondetection or vision-language-model-derived scene complexity as additional confidence signals. The coevaluation will use fixed policies during controlled experiments; online adaptation is an optional extension.     Who Are We?   You will join the Verification & Validation (V&V) Virtual Driver team at V.A.S., focused on ensuring tintegrity of the software stack for autonomous decision-making and control. The team brings togetherdevelopers with varied backgrounds and seniority, all centered around robust V&V practices. Theenvironment is friendly and helpful, with both in-office development and in-vehicle testing.     Who Are You?   You are a final-year Master's student in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, withstrong interest in software architecture, software quality, and building maintainable systems. You arecomfortable programming in Python and interested in extending and evaluating an existing softwareplatform in an industrial setting. You should have a foundation in modular software design, interface design, automated testing, and versioncontrol, together with an interest in empirical software engineering. You should be motivated to comparedesign alternatives and connect architectural decisions with measurable effects on correctnesperformance, maintainability, and testability. Familiarity with AI-assisted systems, machine learning, computer vision, or human-computer interaction isadvantageous, but prior specialization in machine learning or object detection is not required. An interest inlearning enough about model confidence and human verification to make sound software design decisis important.     Why Join Us?   This thesis offers an opportunity to apply software engineering methods to a concrete industrial challengdesigning an adaptive human-AI workflow that is maintainable, testable, and auditable. You will build on existing annotation platform and prior thesis results, taking the work from architectural design throughimplementation and empirical evaluation. You will:      Gain hands-on experience in architectural design, component integration, automated testing, andevaluation of an industrial software system.     Investigate how confidence signals can guide human attention while preserving traceability ahuman oversight.     Measure architectural trade-offs across annotation correctness, performance, maintainabilittestability, and human effort.     Collaborate with engineers working on the validation of autonomous transport solutions.    You will gain practical experience in designing and evaluating human-AI systems in a safety-critical context.We look forward to receiving your application letter, academic transcript, and CV in English.           Preferred start date:  January 2027Application deadline: 15 November 2026   We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Työskentelet roolissa Espoon toimistolla hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä.Tarjoamme:- Mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan kiehtovalle ja kehittyvälle energia-alalle.- Vastuullisen asiantuntijaroolin, jossa pääsee kehittämään osaamistaan ja tekemään itsenäisiä ratkaisuja.- Aseman tiiviissä asiantuntijatiimissä, jossa työskennellään yhdessä yhteisten tavoitteiden eteen.- Toimipisteen Espoossa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä.Työtehtävät- Päivittäinen operatiivinen kaasukauppa: Suoritat kaasun ostosopimusten nominoinnit, siirtokapasiteettitilaukset sekä käyt kauppaa Suomi–Baltia-alueen kaasupörssissä ja hallinnoit Latvian kaasuvarastoa.- Salkun- ja taseenhallinta: Ylläpidät ja kehität kaasun portfoliomallia, tasehallintamallia sekä optimoit kaasun ja biokaasun osto- ja myyntisalkuja.- Markkina-analyysit ja laskelmat: Seuraat Suomen ja Euroopan kaasumarkkinoita, laadit analyyseja sisäiseen käyttöön ja energiamarkkinaviestintään sekä toteutat hinnankiinnityksiä asiakkaille.- Myynnin ja mallien kehitys: Osallistut myynnin hinnoittelumallien, tuoterakenteen sekä hankinnan toimintatapojen ja -työkalujen kehittämiseen osana tiimiä.- Sopimushallinta ja laskutusaineistot: Huolehdit hinnankiinnityssopimusten ylläpidosta, manuaalisesti laskutettavien asiakkaiden laskutusaineistoista ja ostolaskujen tarkastuksesta.- Järjestelmä- ja dataylläpito: Vastaat käytettävien Excel-mallien ja tietojärjestelmien sujuvasta hallinnasta sekä automaattisen datansiirron valvonnasta ja poikkeamien korjaamisesta.Etsimällämme henkilöllä on:- Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. DI, KTM, AMK insinööri tai tradenomi)- Aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavista energia-alan asiantuntijatehtävistä tai tehtävää hyvin tukeva koulutus- Sujuva tietotekninen osaaminen (erityisesti vahva Excel-osaaminen) sekä valmius ottaa nopeasti haltuun kaasukaupan ja salkunhallinnan erikoisjärjestelmät- Sujuva suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen ja englannin kielen taito.- Järjestelmällinen, tarkka ja huolellinen työskentelyote.- Kyky itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon myös kiireen keskellä.- Erinomaiset tiimi- ja vuorovaikutustaidot.Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen salkunhoidosta sekä sähkö-, kaasupörssi- tai arvopaperikaupasta sekä yleisen energia-alan kokemuksen tai koulutuksen.RekrytointiprosessimmeAcademic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Valintaprosessiin sisältyvät luonteenpiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit. Testit toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin.

jobs.title: Sähköasentaja rakennusprojektiin,
jobs.description: Etsimme nyt sähköasentajaa osaksi Harrinivan hotellityömaan rakennusprojektia! Tämä on loistava tilaisuus sinulle, joka haluat olla mukana toteuttamassa merkittävää rakennushanketta ja nautit käytännönläheisestä työstä. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat monipuoliset sähköasennukset, kuten putkitus, kaapelinveto ja kalustus, osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Toivomme sinulta reipasta asennetta ja perustaitoja sähköasennuksista. Sujuva suomen kielen taito auttaa sinua menestymään tehtävässä. Lisäksi tarvitset voimassa olevan sähkötyöturvallisuuskortin. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä mielenkiintoisessa ja vaihtelevassa ympäristössä, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi. Lyhyestä kestosta huolimatta tämä työ tarjoaa arvokasta kokemusta ja mahdollisuuden verkostoitua alan ammattilaisten kanssa. Jos olet valmis tarttumaan haasteeseen ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa jotain ainutlaatuista, tämä paikka voi olla juuri sinua varten. Liity joukkoomme ja tule osaksi projektia, jossa jokaisella on tärkeä rooli!Asiakas tarjoaa majoituksen.

jobs.title: Autosähköasentaja
jobs.description: **Työtehtäväsi vaihtelevat huolloista vaativiin vianetsintöihin ja korjauksiin, joten nykyautojen väylä- ja diagnoositekniikan hallinta on suotavaa. Sähkö- ja hybridiautojen tuntemus on tietenkin plussaa. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä. Kokemuksen ohella yhtä merkitsevää on halu oppia ja kehittyä edelleen sekä positiivinen määrätietoinen asenne.****Tarjoamme sinulle taitojesi mukaisen kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen, koulutusta osaamisesi tueksi ja mahdollisuuden kehittyä osana rautaista ammattilaisten tiimiämme.
