jobs.title: Salivastaava / The Barö
jobs.description: **Intohimona laatu, luonto ja elämykset? Etsimme ravintolasalin esihenkilöä / salivastaavaa The Barö -hotelliin!**Etsimme Inkoon upeaan saaristomaisemaan The Barö -hotelliin energistä, itsenäistä ja sydämellään työtä tekevää ravintolasalin esihenkilöä / salivastaavaa.Jos sinulla on aito intohimo laadukasta ruokaa, juomaa ja ensiluokkaista asiakaspalvelua kohtaan ja haluat olla mukana luomassa unohtumattomia elämyksiä uniikissa premium-ympäristössä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!**Työnkuvasi:**- **Käytännön työnjohto ja sali:** Toimit salitiimin esihenkilönä, minkä lisäksi osallistut aktiivisesti suorittavaan työhön ja toimit itse myös À la carte -tarjoilijana. Varmistat omalla esimerkilläsi, että asiakaspalvelumme laatu on aina ensiluokkaista. - **Juomatuotteen kehittäminen:** Suunnittelet hotellin uniikin cocktail-listan, trendikkäät ja laadukkaat mocktailit sekä vastaat muista juomatuotteista. - **Sommelierin rooli:** Vastaat ravintolamme laadukkaista viineistä, toimit viiniasiantuntijana ja suosittelet asiakkaillemme täydellisiä makupareja. _Etkö ole vielä valmis sommelier? Ei hätää – me The Barössä olemme valmiita kouluttamaan sinut tähän rooliin, jos asenteesi on kohdallaan!_ **Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- Aitoa, palavaa intohimoa ja kiinnostusta ruoka- ja juomakulttuuria sekä korkeatasoista asiakaspalvelua kohtaan. - Sujuvuutta ja varmuutta À la carte -tarjoilussa sekä halua toimia tiimin veturina vauhdikkaissakin tilanteissa. - **Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta:** Hotellimme sijaitsee upealla paikalla luonnon keskellä, jonne ei pääse julkisilla kulkuvälineillä. Tehtävän hoitaminen ja työmatkat edellyttävät siksi omaa autoa. - Arvostamme oikeaa asennetta, oppimishalua ja käytännön kokemusta. **Ravintolamme arki ja rytmi:**Työpäiväsi ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevat viikonpäivien mukaan:- **Viikonloppuisin** tarjoilemme korkeatasoista À la carte -illallista sekä lauantaisin maistuvaa lounasta. - **Arkisin** hotellimme täyttyy yrityskokouksista, yksityistilaisuuksista ja muista tapahtumista, jotka tuovat vaihtelua työviikkoon. **Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**- **Työsuhde ja tunnit:** Kyseessä on vakituinen työsuhde. Tarjolla on täydet tunnit, noin 160 h / kk. - **Palkkaus:** Tuntipalkka MaRa TES mukaisesti. Voit esittää palkkatoiveesi. Alkuvuodesta mahdollisuus siirtyä kuukausipalkkaiseksi suoraan The Barön kirjoille, jolloin kiinteästä kuukausipalkasta sovitaan erikseen. - Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi (esim. sommelier-koulutus) ja vaikuttaa suoraan ravintolamme juoma- ja palvelutuotteeseen. - Upean ja inspiroivan työympäristön sekä lämminhenkisen tiimin tuen. Vuonna 2021 avattu **The Barö** on ekologisesti rakennettu, korkealuokkainen premium-tason boutique-saaristohotelli. Se sijaitsee Inkoon upeassa Barösundissa, vain reilun tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingistä. Hotellikokonaisuus on suunniteltu sulautumaan harmonisesti ympäröivään luontoon sitä kunnioittaen, ja se koostuu uniikeista, erillisistä maisemahuoneista, tyylikkäästä rantasaunasta sekä korkeatasoisesta **The Berg -ravintolasta**. Asiakkaille tarjotaan ensiluokkaisia ruoka- ja juomaelämyksiä, yksilöllistä palvelua sekä rauhoittumista saaristoluonnon syleilyssä ympäri vuoden.**Job To Do** on henkilöstöpalveluyritys, joka on erikoistunut tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan henkilöstötarpeitten täyttämiseen. Tavoitteena on muuttaa henkilöstöpalvelutoimialaa inhimillisemmäksi ja innostavammaksi. Arvojamme ovat joustavuus, ammattitaito, kumppanuus ja turvallisuus. Välitämme ihmisiä, joista välitämme.**Heräsikö kysymyksiä?**Laita meille sähköpostia **rekry@jobtodo.fi**, vastaamme kaikkiin kysymyksiisi. Pidäthän varmuuden vuoksi silmällä myös roskapostikansiotasi.Emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Supply chain manager (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.Safran Helicopter Engines est le leader mondial des moteurs d'hélicoptères et le seul industriel à s'être spécialisé sur ce marché. Implantée dans le monde entier, la société emploie 6100 personnes dans le monde et possède plus de 2 500 clients répartis dans 155 pays et plus de 21 500 moteurs en service.Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.Descriptif missionAs Supply Chain Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and optimising our end-to-end supply chain. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you'll lead strategic procurement, inventory control, and purchasing operations while overseeing Noria, Warranty, Pool, and Logistics activities that keep our production and commercial goals on track. This is a high-impact role where your ability to drive efficiency, ensure on-time delivery, and uphold quality standards will directly contribute to our success, while aligning the supply chain with the company's broader strategic vision.Key ResponsibilitiesAs the Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for leading and optimising key supply chain functions across inventory, logistics, procurement, and team management to support production and commercial goals. Your main responsibilities will include:Inventory Planning & Management:o Develop and maintain accurate inventory forecasts aligned with business needso Balance customer demand with inventory levels to optimise availability and minimise excess stocko Analyse consumption patterns, seasonal trends, and market dynamicso Manage repairable and unserviceable inventory, including buy-back processeso Monitor inventory usage to identify obsolescence risks and recommend solutionso Maintain stock accuracy through cycle counts, stocktakes, and proactive replenishment strategieso Collaborate with suppliers to resolve issues, improve service levels, and support sourcing initiativesLogistics Management:o Oversee transportation services, including providers, freight costs, customs compliance, and export controlso Ensure timely delivery of products and materials while optimising shipping efficiencyo Support warehousing operations, including material handling, storage, and dispatcho Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in logistics and warehouse processesPurchasing & Procurement:o Maintain accurate supplier records and oversee onboarding of new vendorso Manage requests for quotations (RFQs) and source suppliers to meet business requirementso Maintain purchase orders and monitor subcontracted repair activitieso Evaluate vendor performance against quality, delivery, and cost standardsExport Control and Customs Complianceo Provide support to Export Compliance Officer, Customs Compliance Officer and Empowered Official in the execution of Safran Export Control and Customs Compliance Standards.Leadership & Team Management:o Lead, coach, and manage the supply chain team to achieve high performanceo Manage staff qualifications, training, leave, and performance managemento Provide support to Procurement Coordinator, Warehouse Supervisor, and Noria/Warranty/Pool Coordinator

jobs.title: Myyjä kodinturva-alalle
jobs.description: **Myyjänämme edustat Suomen suosituinta kodinturva-alan hälytysjärjestelmää ja työskentelet Great Place to Work -sertifioidussa organisaatiossa. Mikäli tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta työpaikalta, jatka lukemista alta!****Huomioithan, että tämä ei ole kesätyötehtävä. Etsimme myyjiä, jotka haluavat työskennellä meillä kokoaikaisesti myös kesän jälkeen.****Miltä arkesi näyttää meillä?**Myyjänämme liikut Verisuren tarjoamalla käyttöetuautolla ja toimit hälytysjärjestelmäpalvelumme asiantuntijana. Työsi keskiössä on asiakkaan tiloissa tehtävä turvakartoitus, jossa arvioit kohteen turvallisuustarpeet ja suunnittelet siihen parhaan ratkaisun. Tavoitteenasi on rakentaa asiakkaalle räätälöity turvasuojaus ja varmistaa hänen kotinsa tai yritystilojensa turvallisuus.Viikkokalenterisi koostuu valmiiksi sovituista turvakartoituksista sekä itse hankkimistasi asiakaskäynneistä, koulutuksia ja tiimipalavereja unohtamatta. Kun turvakartoitukset alkavat onnistua ja tuottamaan kauppoja, koulutamme sinut asentamaan kaupatut hälytysjärjestelmät asiakkaidesi kohteisiin. Pääset parhaimmillaan tarjoamaan asiakkaallesi kokonaisvaltaisen palvelukokemuksen ensikohtaamisesta tapaamiseen, ja lopulta järjestelmän asentamiseen. Työpäiväsi ovat liikkuvia ja vaihtelevia, ja työtä tehdään arkipäivisin lähtökohtaisesti klo 12:00–20:00. Perehdytyksen jälkeen aikataulut muuttuvat joustavammiksi ja pääset itse vaikuttamaan siihen, miten järjestät asiakaskäyntisi.**Kelle tämä työ sopii?**Mikäli koet syttyväsi tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta ja konkreettisista onnistumisista, löytyy sinulta hyvät eväät työssä menestymiseen. Myös tietty pilke silmäkulmassa kilpailullisuuden suhteen antaa hyvää lisäpotkua tekemiseen. Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta suoramyynnin tai turvallisuusalan parista, mutta voit olla myös esimerkiksi tavoitteellista myyntityötä etsivä alanvaihtaja, joka etsii uusia haasteita uralleen. Kurkkaa urasivuiltamme www.verisure.fi/ura, millaista arki Verisuren myyjänä voi olla.**Mitä edellytämme:**- B-luokan ajokortti (manuaali) ja valmius liikkua työtehtävissä Verisuren käyttöetuautolla. - Sujuvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot suomen kielellä, kyky kohdata asiakkaat ammattimaisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti. - Motivaatio oppia palvelut ja tuotteet sekä kyky toimia tavoitteellisesti ja vastuullisesti. - Tavoitteellisuutta ja innokkuutta suoramyyntiä kohtaan. - Kyky toimia itsenäisesti, suunnitella ja toteuttaa työtehtäviä ilman jatkuvaa ohjausta perehdytyksen ja koulutuksen jälkeen. - Kokemusta asiakastyötä tai itsenäistä tekemistä sisältävistä rooleista. - Käytännön valmiudet ottaa asiakaskohtaamiset ja päätöksenteko hallintaan kenttätyössä. - Turvasuojaajakortin edellyttämä nuhteettomuus rikosrekisterissä. Neuvomme kortin hankinnassa aina työsuhteen alkaessa. **Tarjoamme sinulle:**- Kannustavan palkkamallin, maksamme noin 300€/kauppa provisioista. Keskimäärin myyjämme tienaavat noin **3000-5000€ / kk**, ja parhaiten tienaavat yltävät **10 000€ / kk tai sen yli.** - **Takuupalkan 2000€/kk** työsuhteen kolmena ensimmäisenä kuukautena, joka koostuu 500€ pohjapalkasta ja 1500€/kk takuuprovisiosta. Tuemme alkuvaiheen onnistumistasi maksamalla korotettuja provisioita työn ensimmäisten kuukausin aikana. - Käyttöetuauton, jolla pääset liikkumaan sekä työ- että vapaa-ajalla. - Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen koko työsuhteesi aikana. Aloitat työsi neljän päivän koulutuskurssilla toimistolla, jonka jälkeen perehdytys jatkuu kentällä yhdessä kouluttajien sekä esihenkilösi kanssa. Katso Youtube kanavaltamme (Verisure Suomi) videoltakouluttajamme Peterin esittely siitä, miten koulutamme sinut tehtävään. - Miellyttävän ja välittävän työyhteisön. Olemme myös tutkitusti hyvä työnantaja. Meille on myönnetty Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti. Lisäksi sijoituimme Suomen parhaat työpaikat -gaalassa keskisuurten yritysten kategoriassa. - Yhteistä tekemistä ja paljon erilaisia tapahtumia. Pääset esimerkiksi tutustumaan sekä näkemään eri kaupungeissa työskenteleviä myyjiä koko firman myyntitapahtumien yhteydessä, tai nauttimaan koko organisaatiolle järjestettävässä Inspiration Day –kesätapahtumassa. - Myyntikilpailuja, joista voit voittaa mm. Ulkomaanmatkoja. Katso tästäInstagram tililtämme video myyjiemme palkintomatkasta Saksaan. - Mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi – tällä hetkellä lähes jokainen kenttämyynnin esihenkilö on edennyt tehtäväänsä talon sisältä. Katso tarinoita urasivuiltamme sekä sosiaalisen median tileiltämme. - Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten käyttöetuauto, kattava työterveyshuolto Mehiläisellä, hammaslääkärietu, lounasetu, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut. Pääset tutustumaan meihin sekä Verisuren myyntityöhön tarkemmin sosiaalisen median tiliemme kautta TikTokissa ja Instagramissa @verisurelaiset.**Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**Verisuren myyjänä seisot ylpeästi tuotteesi takana ja turvaat samalla ihmisten kodit sekä yritystilat suomen suosituimmalla sekä luotetuimmalla kodinturva-alan palvelulla. Lähetä hakemus tehtävään sivulla olevasta linkistä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia hakuaikana, ja paikat täytetään aina sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä.Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit tarvittaessa tiedustella rekrytiimiltä sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekry@verisure.fi.

jobs.title: Technical Plant Support Technician
jobs.description:
Als Technical Plant Support Technician (TPS) ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt bij storingen van utilities installaties. (Elektriciteit, cooling & heating, HVAC).

  • Je neemt het alarm aan op het alert-systeem en doet de eerstelijnsinterventie. Bij uitvallen van de installatie neem je acties om de installatie binnen de kortst mogelijke tijdspanne terug operationeel te krijgen.
  • Je werkt hierbij steeds volgens de geldende Pfizer veiligheidsprocedures en algemene GMP.
  • Correct rapporteren van voorvallen in een gevalideerd systeem behoort ook tot de taak en is belangrijk voor verdere impactbepaling door QA.
  • Je werkt zeer kwaliteitsgericht en volgt afspraken na, ook al sta je onder tijdsdruk.
  • Je escaleert (wederkerende) storingen en doet samen met de zone-ingenieurs onderzoek naar grondoorzaken, waarbij je ook voorstellen doet ter verbetering.
  • Preventieve- en curatieve onderhoudstaken behoren eveneens tot je takenpakket.
  • Daarnaast doe je ook periodieke checks op installaties volgens voorgeschreven controlelijsten. (nooddiesels, sprinklerinstallaties, stoomketels, waterinstallaties, …)
  • Je hecht veel belang aan veilig werken. Je meldt onveilige situaties aan supervisie en spreekt collega´s aan op onveilige handelingen of onveilig gedrag.
  • Je zal werken in een vijfploegensysteem.
  • Bachelor diploma in elektromechanica, Elektriciteit, HVAC of gelijkwaardig door relevante ervaring
  • Zeer brede technische kennis: Hoogspanning, sterkstroom, mechanisch, pneumatisch, meet- en regeltechniek, automatisatie
  • Zin om complexe problemen te analyseren
  • Prioriteiten inschatten op basis van algemene richtlijnen
  • Autonoom aan de slag gaan
  • Vlotte en duidelijke communicatie naar collega's en interne klanten
  • Objectief rapporteren op basis van feiten en meetcijfers
  • Kwaliteitsgericht werken

jobs.title: Safeguarding Lead - Safeguarding Unit (f/x/m) - Brussels
jobs.description:
Global Safeguarding Strategy and Culture

  • Enhance and oversee the delivery of the OCB Safeguarding Strategy ensuring it is enhanced, developed, and maintained and monitored, and is a mainstreamed issue within OCB

  • Provide strategic vision to drive through essential, systematic integration of SG into all of OCB's work

  • Act as strategic lead for all constituents of safeguarding in OCB operations, with specific emphasis on preventative aspects of work

  • Build a culture that embodies a consistent tone, energy and language on Safeguarding

  • In close collaboration with OCB departments and Executive Leadership Team, drive the integration of safeguarding roles and responsibilities throughout all aspects of OCB's work

OCB Safeguarding Systems, Policies and Systems

  • Ensure that standards of safeguarding are maintained across all parts of OCB

  • Ensure a robust and effective case management process & work to enhance the case management system

  • Ensure the development of staff capacity through the promotion and embedding of safeguarding policies and procedures across the movement

  • Oversee the Case Management and Reporting Standard Operating Procedure (SOPs)

  • Enhance and maintain OCB Safeguarding standards and Operating Procedures to take into consideration learning through implementation and necessary changes

Thought Leadership and Influencing

  • Participate in stakeholder engagement including participation in international sector platforms on safeguarding, benchmarking market best practice and positioning OCB as a thought subject -matter leader

  • Strengthen the SG voice within program design, risk assessment and mitigation and safe programming in a coordinated and consistent way

  • Ensure the integration of safe programming and safeguarding risk management throughout the project cycle, including safe and accessible community-based reporting mechanisms for SEAH and adequate safeguarding response capacity at country level, in close collaboration with the Operational Department

  • Lead the coordination of safeguarding positioning and external engagement within the wider sector and represent OCB externally on sector wide debates on safeguarding management

Leadership of Safeguarding resources

  • Engage with the members of the IPOB and Safeguarding network of colleagues across the movement

  • Lead, support, and develop the OCB Safeguarding Team

  • Management and leadership of the safeguarding team

  • Ownership and management of the Safeguarding Unit budget

  • Work with the HR Director to ensure compliance with safeguarding policies, including safe recruitment practices

  • Monitor activity to ensure there is an adequate resource for the Safeguarding Unit

Education & Experience

  • Relevant qualification in safeguarding, law, ethics, social work, gender-based violence or a related field, and/or at least five (5) years' experience preventing, detecting and responding to sexual exploitation, abuse, harassment and other forms of misconduct

  • Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (SEAH) investigation qualification (e.g. CHS Tier 3, CFE, CFF, CPA, CCEP or equivalent recognised certification)
  • Minimum five (5) years' experience in a strategic role within a complex organisation
  • Minimum five (5) years' experience working within an international NGO, UN agency or comparable international environment
  • Experience leading or conducting safeguarding investigations and managing highly sensitive and confidential matters
  • Experience working in multicultural and transversal environments and building trust across all organisational levels
  • Experience leading and developing multicultural teams

Competencies

  • Critical thinking, analytical and decision-making skills for the protection of vulnerable people

  • People management, team leadership and influencing skills in complex organisational cultures
  • Strong cross-cultural communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience in multicultural and transversal environments
  • Ability to synthesise information from multiple sources with strong attention to detail
  • Experience drafting strategic documents, policies, standard operating procedures and guidelines
  • Strong organisational and time management skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion
  • Strong commitment to creating a safe working environment where people are heard and concerns are addressed
  • Integrity, ethical judgement and self-awareness

Languages

  • Proficiency of English, both written and spoken is mandatory

  • Good knowledge of French, Spanish, or Arabic is an asset

Other

  • Availability for international travel, including programme visits and safeguarding-related meetings

jobs.title: Service Advisor - Boortmeerbeek
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen als Service Advisor bij BMW?

  • Je verwelkomt klanten die langskomen voor onderhoud of herstelling van hun wagen en zorgt meteen voor een vriendelijke en professionele ontvangst. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt en zorgt ervoor dat elke klant zich gehoord en geholpen voelt.
  • Je maakt een duidelijke en efficiënte planning op waarbij je rekening houdt met de wensen van de klant, de capaciteit van de werkplaats en de beschikbaarheid van onderdelen. Je vormt hierbij de belangrijke schakel tussen de klant en de werkplaats.
  • Dankzij jouw proactieve en positieve communicatie blijven klanten steeds goed op de hoogte van de voortgang van de werken en eventuele wijzigingen.
  • Je volgt klantendossiers nauwkeurig op en zorgt ervoor dat alle administratie correct en overzichtelijk verwerkt wordt.
  • Bij de teruggave van de wagen neem je de tijd om samen met de klant de uitgevoerde werken en de factuur te overlopen. Eventuele vragen of opmerkingen behandel je professioneel en oplossingsgericht.
  • Je streeft elke dag naar een uitstekende klantentevredenheid en bouwt met jouw servicegerichte aanpak aan een duurzame relatie met de klant.

Waarmee kan je ons team versterken?

  • Je bent een enthousiaste autoliefhebber die graag bijleert. Ervaring in een gelijkaardige functie is een pluspunt, maar je servicegerichte ingesteldheid is het belangrijkste.
  • Je zet je elke dag in voor een uitmuntende klantenervaring en bent een echte ambassadeur van BMW.
  • Een gezonde dosis administratief werk schrikt je niet af en je bent organisatorisch sterk.
  • Je bent een vlotte communicator die zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband goed functioneert.
  • Je denkt oplossingsgericht en neemt initiatief.
  • Woorden zoals communicatief, positief, stressbestendig en flexibel passen perfect bij jouw persoonlijkheid.

jobs.title: Omscholen tot rijinstructeur? LesGO zoekt rijinstructeurs!
jobs.description: LesGO is een jonge, dynamische organisatie die gaat voor het beste. Wanneer wij een samenwerking aangaan kun je rekenen op een prettige communicatie en een goede ondersteuning. LesGO investeert blijvend in haar ondernemers. Denk aan het continu aanleveren van nieuwe leerlingen, landelijke marketingactiviteiten, het blijvend verbeteren van het rijschoolconcept en een administratieve ondersteuning . Dat maakt ons vaak een stap sneller dan de concurrent en dit zie je terug in de verdiensten!  Nog niet de juiste papieren, maar wil je wel rijinstructeur worden? Haal dan je papieren via de LesGO Academie. Let op: in sommige gevallen wordt de opleiding vergoed door de uitkerende instantie. Vraag ons naar de mogelijkheden voor uw traject. Rijinstructeur worden lag nog nooit eerder zo dicht binnen handbereik! Een vrij beroep zonder directe controle van een baas, waar vind je dat nog? LesGO Academie verzorgt jouw korte omscholing tot rijinstructeur binnen 4 tot 6 maanden, afhankelijk van hoe snel jij wilt. Vraag zelfs naar de mogelijkheden om je opleiding te laten bekostigen! Vooraf krijg je (na een intake) de baangarantie zwart op wit, zodat je direct aansluitend na je opleiding direct aan het werk kunt, bij een van de verkeersscholen in ons relatienetwerk of bij een Verkeersschool naar je eigen keuze. Bij ons ben je daarin helemaal vrij en we helpen je graag daar waar jij dat nodig vindt. Kortom, een unieke (tweede?) kans voor een mooie en leuke baan. 50 plus juist ook meer dan welkom!

jobs.title: Order picker in day shift - open to English speakers!
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.title: Wegenwerker
jobs.description:

Wat deze werkgever zo bijzonder maakt, is dat ze alles zelf doen: van de productie tot de uitvoering. Dat zorgt voor topkwaliteit, innovatie én werkzekerheid. Medewerkers krijgen volop kansen om te groeien, samen te werken in sterke teams én mee te bouwen aan projecten om trots op te zijn.

Hier draait het om meer dan werken alleen. Welzijn, teamspirit en een goede balans tussen werk en privé zijn erg belangrijk. Wie hier start, krijgt niet alleen een job, maar echt een toekomst.

Solliciteren? Eerst heb je een gesprek met HR en daarna krijg je de kans om ter plaatse te zien hoe de job écht is. Je ontmoet meteen je mogelijke collega’s. Grijp deze kans en bouw mee aan morgen!

  • Grond- en rioleringswerken

  • Leggen van klinkers en borduren
  • Opwerken van putdeksels

  • Je werkt veilig en georganiseerd.

jobs.title: Rioolarbeider
jobs.description:
Deze aannemer met de vacature van rioolarbeider te Aalst is actief in de wegenbouw, rioleringsaanleg, milieusanering en de aanleg van publieke ruimtes. Hun projecten zijn voor zowel publieke als private opdrachtgevers in Vlaanderen en Brussel. Het bedrijf behoort tot de top 3 spelers op de Belgische infrastructuurmarkt. Vanuit verschillende vestigingen beschikken ze over eigen betonsites, recyclagesites en asfaltproductie-installaties. De bedrijfscultuur is open en samenwerkend: collega’s ondersteunen elkaar om veilig en kwalitatief werk te leveren. Kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid staan centraal, met aandacht voor planning, correcte uitvoering en ruimte om te leren en te groeien.

Jobomschrijving

Als rioolarbeider in de regio Aalst werk je samen met je ploeg op verschillende werven en voer je het onderstaande takenpakket uit:

  • Je vertrekt met je team vanaf een afgesproken opstapplaats in de regio Aalst naar de werf en stemt ter plaatse de dagplanning af met de ploegbaas en werfleiding.
  • Je voert rioleringswerken uit, zoals het maken van huisaansluitingen, het plaatsen van rioleringsbuizen en putten, en het ophogen of vrijmaken van putdeksels.
  • Je plaatst en werkt weginfrastructuur af, waaronder funderingen, kolken, boordstenen, goten en straat- of klinkerwerken.
  • Je gebruikt klein bouwmaterieel en gereedschap voor grond- en wegenwerken, zoals trilplaten, slijpschijven en (kleine) graafmachines.
  • Je houdt de werf ordelijk en veilig, controleert hoogtes en uitzettingen waar nodig, en helpt mee om de uitvoering volgens planning te laten verlopen.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Hieronder vind je wat je nodig hebt om op te starten als rioolarbeider voor deze job in de regio Aalst:

  • Je raakt iedere ochtend vlot tot een ophaalpunt in de regio Aalst.
  • Je hebt al (een eerste) ervaring als grondwerker, arbeider in rioleringswerken of wegenwerker.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om te starten als rioolarbeider en je wil fysiek werken in weer en wind.
  • Je hebt een geldig rijbewijs B of bent er concreet mee aan de slag (praktijklessen en/of praktijkexamen ingepland).
  • Je hecht belang aan veilig en vlot communiceren op de werf.
  • Je kan vroeg starten en je bent flexibel naar werkuren, overuren en werven op verschillende locaties.
De ideale collega is...
  • Iemand die graag werkt in teamverband, vlot afstemt met ploegbaas en collega’s en meehelpt waar nodig om samen vooruitgang te maken.
  • Iemand die veiligheid en orde op de werf serieus neemt: je volgt afspraken, gebruikt materiaal correct en spreekt risico’s tijdig aan.
  • Iemand die flexibel is in werkritme en planning, met bereidheid om vroeg te starten en in overleg extra uren te doen wanneer de werfplanning dat vraagt.
  • Iemand die houdt van buitenwerk en fysiek werk, ook bij wisselende weersomstandigheden: je blijft doorzetten tot het werk klaar is.
  • Iemand die graag slimmer wordt via opleiding en begeleiding on the job.
  • Iemand die nieuwe werkwijzen en technieken snel toepast in de praktijk.

jobs.title: Grondwerker / wegenwerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij gepassioneerd door ruwbouw en blijf jij graag met beide voeten op de grond? 

We zijn op zoek naar nieuwe teamleden om onze huidige teams in de regio Antwerpen te versterken. Ons bedrijf is actief in diverse infrastructuurprojecten, variërend van wegenwerken tot asfalt- en betonproductie, inclusief laboratoriumwerk, signalisatie- en onderhoudsdiensten.

Als grondwerker / wegenwerker zal je werken aan grote projecten zoals tunnels, bruggen en stedelijke projecten. Dit binnen een stabiel team en met goede apparatuur om je werk soepel te laten verlopen.

Je takenpakket omvat onder meer:

  • Plaatsing van borduren
  • Rioolaansluiting
  • Algemene grondwerken
  • Beton uitschoten
  • Kolken plaatsen in het wegdek
  • Etc.

Je zal regelmatig in contact komen met buizen van 2 tot 3 meter breed. Daarom vereisen we ervaring met dergelijke grote materialen.

Een rijbewijs is verplicht binnen ons bedrijf, zodat je indien nodig het stuur kunt overnemen. Nacht- of weekendwerk kan worden gevraagd, met een extra toeslag op het loon. Naast de standaardvergoeding ontvang je ook maaltijdcheques (€5.60/dag) en Benefits@Work.

Wij investeren in persoonlijke groei en bieden tal van opleidingsmogelijkheden. 

Wil jij deel uitmaken van een sterke speler in de infrastructuursector?

  • Kennis van de Nederlandse taal
  • Ervaring binnen grond / wegenwerken
  • Rijbewijs B

jobs.description: IT Security Officer - IT ResilienceLocations Luxembourg (Siège Lux House)time type Full timejob requisition id REQ-10123443IT Security Officer - IT ResilienceYour role & work environmentING Luxembourg is looking for an IT Security Officer – IT Resilience (m/f) for an internal vacancy within the IT Security team. The role focuses on strengthening IT resilience, with particular responsibility for backup and recovery assurance, ransomware preparedness, security risk management and regulatory alignment.You will work across Technology, risk and assurance functions to translate security requirements into practical improvements, provide constructive challenge and support informed decision-making. You will join a bilingual team of IT Security and Identity and Access Management Officers. The team works closely with Technology, Information Risk Management, the CIO management team, ING Group security functions and other ING entities to strengthen the bank's security and operational resilience.Your key responsibilities• Translate Luxembourg regulatory obligations, technology requirements and ING Group standards into clear local control requirements, and coordinate their implementation with Technology teams and control owners. • Perform and challenge cyber and IT risk assessments, ensuring that threats, vulnerabilities, control effectiveness, residual risk and proportionate mitigation measures are clearly documented. • Own and monitor security remediation plans, agree priorities and target dates with accountable stakeholders, and escalate material delays or risk acceptance decisions. • Drive improvements in IT resilience, including backup governance, recovery testing, restoration assurance, resilience against destructive attacks and follow-up of identified weaknesses. • Coordinate security reviews, control testing, audit and regulatory requests—including DORA-related activities—with assurance functions, ING Group experts and relevant third parties. • Provide concise reporting on risk exposure, control performance, remediation progress, key issues and required decisions to local management and ING Group stakeholders. • Advise delivery teams on security requirements and pragmatic risk treatment, helping them make timely, risk-informed decisions throughout the change lifecycle. • Contribute to the IT Security team's operational activities, including security incident monitoring and analysis, control oversight, audit support and emerging priorities. We look for A colleague with a talent for taking it on and making it happen, enthusiasm for helping others to be successful and a knack for always being a step ahead. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems. As a IT Security Officer – IT Resilience you will also need: • Master's degree in information security, computer science, risk management or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. • At least five years of relevant experience in IT security, IT risk, technology risk or security governance, including delivery across multiple teams or functions. • Sound knowledge of cyber and IT risk management, security controls and regulatory expectations, with practical familiarity with frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, OWASP, PCI DSS and DORA. • Demonstrated ability to assess control design and effectiveness, define proportionate remediation measures, and communicate risk clearly to technical and management audiences. • Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, ideally covering IT resilience, backup and recovery governance, recovery testing, immutable or segregated backups, and ransomware resilience. • A relevant professional certification, such as CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CBCI or a recognised project-management qualification. • Awareness of the purpose and control considerations of core security technologies, including firewalls, proxies, data loss prevention, endpoint protection and detection, privileged access management, web application firewalls and security information and event management. • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience using workflow, governance or service-management tools such as ServiceNow. • Familiarity with agile delivery and DevSecOps practices; exposure to Git, Azure Pipelines or scripting is an advantage. • Analytical judgement, with the ability to identify material issues, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into prioritised actions. • Clear and persuasive communication, with effective stakeholder management across technical teams, control functions and senior management. • A structured, pragmatic and results-oriented approach, combined with accountability and the confidence to challenge constructively. • Curiosity about emerging threats and technologies, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt priorities in a changing environment. • Fluent written and spoken English is required. Working knowledge of French is considered an advantage. We redefine banking. What about you? There has never been a more interesting time to work at ING. We're on a journey that's centred around our customers, powered by technology and driven by smart, determined people. Our customers feel our people are empowering them to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We're proud of that!

jobs.title: Grondwerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij iemand die energie haalt uit buiten werken, afwisseling en zichtbaar resultaat? Zoek je een job waarin je niet achter een bureau zit, maar elke dag meebouwt aan infrastructuur die écht gebruikt wordt? In deze functie combineer je techniek, beweging en verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent vaak onderweg, werkt op uiteenlopende locaties en geen dag voelt hetzelfde aan. Je krijgt vertrouwen, ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en maakt tegelijk deel uit van een team dat voor elkaar klaarstaat. Veiligheid, kwaliteit en trots op je werk staan centraal. Deze job is ideaal voor wie graag praktisch bezig is, houdt van machines en voldoening haalt uit werk dat tastbaar is. Als jij graag initiatief neemt en je werkdag het liefst in de buitenlucht doorbrengt, dan is dit een uitdaging waarin je je helemaal kan vinden.Jouw taken:

  • Ondergrondse kabels en leidingen correct aanbrengen en afdekken.
  • Sleuven en werkputten maken met machines en manueel gereedschap.
  • Aansluitingen voorbereiden en OV-palen plaatsen.
  • Kabels trekken en verschillende nutsvoorzieningen installeren.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het bedienen van een graafmachine en autolaadkraan.
  • Je hebt een technisch diploma of gelijkwaardige praktijkervaring.
  • Je werkt flexibel en hebt een sterke focus op veilig werken.
  • Je functioneert goed zelfstandig én in samenwerking met collega’s.
  • Je werkt graag buiten en schrikt niet terug voor fysiek werk.
  • Je bent hoofdzakelijk overdag inzetbaar, met bereidheid tot occasioneel nacht- of weekendwerk.
  • Je hebt geen hoogtevrees, ervaring met een hoogtewerker is mooi meegenomen.
  • Een VCA-attest is een extra pluspunt.

jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship field of Sociology (Soziologe/Soziologin)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Sociology. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Susann Wagenknecht, Chair of Micro-Sociology and Technosocial Interaction.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Sociology, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- The (conflict-ridden) negotiation of imaginaries, infrastructures, institutional frameworks, and/or externalities (e.g., emissions, waste, waste heat) associated with energy production and supply across a wide variety of practices, communities, networks, organizations, markets, fields, and/or assemblagesTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree in Sociology or a comparable field in the social sciences, as well as relevant previous experience in the sociological analysis of the environment, technology, or energy, and/or in the field of Science and Technology Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatoryWe offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application: Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-008, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Prof. Dr. Susann Wagenknecht, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship in the field of Art History (Kunsthistoriker/in)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Art History. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Kerstin Schankweiler, Chair of Visual Studies and Art History.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Art History, the focus is on the twentieth and twenty-first centuries. The following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Artistic engagements with ecological crises and their intersections with social, gender-related, and political conflicts, with a particular interest in art in the context of the GDR and the post-1989 transformation period- Extractivism, material resources, and artistic practice in the context of (neo-)colonial power relations and global resource economies, with a particular interest in art from Africa and the African diaspora- AI and digital image cultures, with a focus on the material and energy infrastructures of digital image production and artistic practice- Visual politics of protest and activism in energy, climate, and resource conflicts, as well as their circulation across analog and digital publicsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Art History. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree in Art History or Visual Culture Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-006, by November 20, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Prof. Dr. Kerstin Schankweiler, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis)

jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship in the field of International Politics (Politologe/Politologin)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of International Politics. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Anna Holzscheiter, Chair of Political Science with a focus on International Politics.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of International Politics, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Research on the transnational transition of energy cultures by linking Political Science and International Relations with Social Movement Studies, Sociology, or Conflict Studies- Energy transformation as a political and social distributional conflict in the context of global governance and transnational networks- Challenges of cross-border labour relations in the context of the energy transition, and as objects of analysis for Global Social Policy, Transnational Advocacy Networks, and international norm research- Analysis of legitimation strategies for international objectives (e.g., CO2 reduction) at the national and local levels, particularly in the context of labour- Investigation of global and transnational issues in local contexts, for example through the application of qualitative, comparative, and ethnographic methodsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Political Science/International Relations/Political Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree (Master's or equivalent) in Political Science or a comparable social science discipline. Furthermore, you have relevant prior experience in the application of social science methods as well as in the fields of International Politics and Social Movement Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters), and, where applicable, details of your family situation. Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-003, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Prof. Dr. Anna Holzscheiter, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Strategische/r Einkäufer/in; Technische/r Einkäufer/inStellenbeschreibung:About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude.In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.The RoleBlack Semiconductor is looking for a Strategic Procurement Manager (f/m/d) or Category Manager (f/m/d) to strengthen our growing team in Aachen, Germany. You will ensure continuity of supply, optimize total cost of ownership, and maintain quality compliance while adapting to evolving technology requirements and market conditions.To join our team, you should be excited to take ownership of:- Develop and execute global sourcing strategies for semiconductor materials, including wafers, photoresists, CMP slurries, specialty gases, chemicals, and other critical materials.- Identify, qualify, and manage strategic suppliers while ensuring alignment with technology roadmaps, quality standards, and production requirements.- Negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms to achieve cost targets while securing reliable supply.- Monitor semiconductor material markets, supplier performance, pricing trends, and supply chain risks to identify opportunities and mitigation strategies.- Collaborate with R&D, process engineering, quality, and manufacturing teams to align material requirements with technology and production needs.- Support new product introductions by sourcing materials that meet emerging process requirements and scalability targets.- Manage procurement performance, supplier relationships, and reporting activities to support business objectives.Your Profile- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in supply chain management, engineering, physics, materials science, business, or a related field.- 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, preferably within semiconductors, electronics, or advanced manufacturing.- Proven experience negotiating contracts, managing suppliers, and driving cost optimization initiatives.- Strong understanding of semiconductor materials and processes, including wafers, specialty gases, chemicals, photoresists, lithography, etching, and metallization materials.- Strong analytical skills with experience using ERP/procurement systems and data analysis tools.- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluent English; German language skills are considered an advantage.- Willing to work on-site at our Aachen office at least once a week.Our work culturePeople Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what mattersLet’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal developmentYour Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and futureWe Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forwardWe connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? jobs.title: Senior Officer (d/f/m) Fundraising Development (Fundraiser/in)
jobs.description: IRC (International Rescue Committee) Germany is looking for aSenior Officer (d/f/m) Fundraising Development(Maternity Cover)- Berlin or Remote (within Germany) | Starting December 1st 2026- in full-time/part-time (32–40 hours/week) | Initially limited to 7 monthsABOUT USFounded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC offers lifesaving care and life-changing assistance to refugees forced to flee from war or disaster. In 2016, IRC Germany was founded and engages in global humanitarian work as well as throughout Germany in the areas of education, economic wellbeing, and safety, legal protection, and empowerment.PURPOSE OF THE ROLEThe role is situated within IRC's Mass Market Fundraising Team (MMDE), which is responsible for the acquisition, development and stewardship of individual donors in Germany, with the primary goal of maximizing the lifetime value of new and existing donors.As Senior officer Fundraising development, you play a key role in planning and creating content and communications that inspire donations and promote an engaging donor experience. Your work focuses on strengthening donor engagement and increasing fundraising revenue. You will work across two connected pillars, namely content development and programme development, that together drive donor acquisition, retention and development for IRC Germany.MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES- Create engaging content for donor journeys and donor communications across- digital acquisition, email, direct mail, and telemarketing to increase donations- and donor engagement.- Support colleagues in the private market with audience-specific content, such- as face-to-face pitches and website copy.- Work with colleagues in other national markets and the global support team to- keep content aligned and share ideas.- Test and improve content and formats on an ongoing basis to raise income- and impact with different audiences.- Analyse web and digital campaign performance across IRC Germany's- fundraising efforts, and use the findings to guide content and testing decisions- and give prospects and supporters a great digital experience.- Take responsibility for how your activity performs against agreed KPIs and- income targets, and make sure campaign reports capture learnings for future activity.YOUR PROFILEEssential:- Relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience (at least 2-4- years) in donor and/or customer acquisition, retention, and content- development, ideally in a non-profit or NGO context- Proven ability using analytics and reporting to inform channel and content- decisions and measure success against key KPIs, primarily ROI- Experience creating and adapting fundraising content and messaging across- formats and channels, including design tools such as Canva or Adobe- Creative Cloud, especially Adobe Premiere- Experience using Salesforce or an equivalent CRM- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in German (C1 level or- above, according to the Common European Framework of Reference for- Languages, CEFR), and fluent in English- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office (especially Excel)- Desirable:- Experience working with agencies, external consultants, and vendors- Experience and knowledge in applying AI tools to support fundraising- activities, such as content creation, campaign optimization, or data analysisPreferred:- Experience working in a centralized or international organization, or in other- cross-team and cross-country collaborationWe Offer- Meaningful work within a collaborative team- A starting salary of 51,428.58 Euro gross per year as well as an annual salary- increase- Attractive employee benefits such as gym membership, company pension scheme,- shopping vouchers, childcare subsidy, job bike leasing, subsidized Deutschlandticket- (national public transport), and access to timely and confidential psychological- support if needed- 30 days of annual leave and special leave days- Flexible hybrid-work options (working hours, office/homebased)- Training and professional development opportunities, including access to free- language courses- Assistance services for people with disabilities, if required.We look forward to receiving your application (including CV and – if available – three references) via our application portal – even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by email.For questions regarding the position, please contact Burrhus Njanjo (HR.Deutschland@rescue.org).As an organization committed to an empowering work environment, equal opportunities, and against any form of discrimination, we welcome applications from people regardless of their origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disabilities, age, or other characteristics protected by applicable law. We particularly encourage people with personal or family experience of flight and migration to apply.With equal qualifications, we give preference to applications from people with severe disabilities. If you have any questions about accessible applications or inclusion, please feel free to contact our Inclusion Officer, Christine Mader (christine.mader@rescue.org).To ensure equal opportunities, we kindly ask you to refrain from including photos in your application documents.Please submit your application November 9, 2026.All IRC workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way -Standards for Professional Conduct. On this basis, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti-Retaliation. Please find more information on IRCDeutschland.org.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.title: Projektleiter:in Regulatory Affairs – Medizinsoftware (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: Große Projekte, komplexe Anforderungen und jede Menge Verantwortung sind genau Dein Ding? Bei uns bringst Du die Zertifizierung unserer medizinischen Software voran, hältst die Fäden zwischen verschiedenen Teams zusammen und kannst Deine regulatorische Expertise einbringen oder gezielt weiterentwickeln.Wo Du mit anpacken kannst- Du übernimmst die Steuerung unserer Zertifizierungsprojekte nach der Medizinprodukteverordnung (MDR) und hältst Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten und Risiken im Blick – von der ersten Planung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.- Ob Entwicklung, Produktmanagement, Qualitätsmanagement oder externe Partner: Du bringst alle Beteiligten an einen Tisch und sorgst dafür, dass alle auf dasselbe Ziel hinarbeiten.- Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Expert:innen aus Qualitätsmanagement und Regulatorik zusammen. Dabei bringst Du Deine eigene Expertise ein oder baust sie gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter aus.- Bei Dir verliert sich nichts im Papierdschungel. Du behältst Nachweise, Dokumente und Verantwortlichkeiten im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Zertifizierungsunterlagen vollständig und aktuell bleiben.- Regulatorik und agile Softwareentwicklung müssen sich nicht im Weg stehen. Du hilfst dabei, Freigabe- und Änderungsprozesse so zu gestalten, dass Qualität und Entwicklungstempo zusammenpassen.- Zeitpläne, Ressourcen und Budgets hast Du fest im Griff. Du berichtest regelmäßig an unsere Geschäftsführung und sprichst offen an, wenn irgendwo nachgesteuert werden muss.- Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und kommst für regelmäßige persönliche Abstimmungen nach Jena.Was Du mitbringen solltest- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer, bereichsübergreifender Projekte mit.- Idealerweise kennst Du bereits ein reguliertes Umfeld, beispielsweise Medizintechnik, Pharma, Automotive, Luftfahrt oder Finanzwesen, in dem Dokumentation und Nachweise zum Alltag gehören.- Du behältst nicht nur das große Ganze im Blick, sondern schaust auch bei den Details genau hin. Schließlich sollen am Ende nicht nur die Ergebnisse stimmen, sondern auch die Nachweise dazu.- Neue Themen schrecken Dich nicht ab – im Gegenteil! Du hast Lust, Dich tief mit Medizinprodukten und Regulatorik zu beschäftigen und Deine Expertise weiter auszubauen.- Auch wenn viele Fäden gleichzeitig zusammenlaufen, behältst Du einen kühlen Kopf, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass Fristen nicht heimlich an Dir vorbeiziehen.- Du kommunizierst klar, bringst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen und sprichst Risiken lieber frühzeitig an, statt sie unter den Teppich zu kehren.- Erfahrung mit der MDR oder der Zertifizierung von Medizinprodukten ist ein großes Plus – egal ob Du bereits Zertifizierungsprojekte begleitet hast oder erste Berührungspunkte mitbringst. Auch Kenntnisse in Softwareentwicklung, Qualitätsmanagementsystemen wie ISO 9001, ISO 13485 oder ISO 27001 sowie Audits sind willkommen.- KI-Tools gehören für Dich bereits zum Arbeitsalltag. Du nutzt sie gerne, um Informationen aufzubereiten, Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen und Deine Arbeit effizienter zu gestalten.- Um bei uns richtig Fuß zu fassen, beherrschst Du Deutsch fließend auf mindestens C1-Niveau und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.Warum wir?Wir sind ein offenes und ambitioniertes Team von über 500 Mitarbeitern, das Kundenorientierung wirklich lebt und gleichzeitig Spaß hat. Bei uns herrscht auch nach über 10 Jahren eine Startup-Atmosphäre, die neben dem legendären Obstkorb auch vielseitige Perks wie eine steuerfreie Shoppingkarte, Dienstrad-Leasing und Gesundheitskurse (z.B. Yoga, Rückentraining und mental Health) anbietet - sowohl online als auch im Büro.Je nach Einsatzgebiet (und das sind mindestens 75% aller Unternehmensbereiche) bieten wir all unseren Kollegen flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office an. Wir verstehen uns als eng zusammenhaltendes Team mit Kooperations- statt Wettbewerbs-Atmosphäre. Außerhalb der Arbeit organisieren wir Events wie Beachvolleyball im Sommer, Grillfeste, Kochabende oder Paddeltouren.Deine Vorteile bei uns:- Super Team und flache Hierarchien- Job Crafting/individuelle Arbeitsgestaltung- Flexible Arbeitszeiten- Weiterentwicklung- Home Office/Mobiles Arbeiten- Team Events- Förderung der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge- Betriebliche Krankenversicherung- Dienstradleasing/Jobrad- Hardwareleasing- Mitarbeiterrabatte- Betreuungkostenzuschuss/ Kita-Zuschuss- Erholungsbeihilfe- Essenszuschuss- Fahrtkostenzuschuss- AuslandsarbeitÜberzeugt? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt bei uns!Lade deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung inklusive Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und der relevanten Zeugnisse (Schul-, Ausbildungs-, Uni- und Arbeitszeugnisse) ganz einfach online auf unserer Homepage hoch. Vergiss bitte nicht, auch Deinen möglichen Starttermin und Deine Gehaltsvorstellung mit anzugeben.Du hast noch Fragen? Dann wende dich an unsere Personalabteilung. Sabrina, Julia, Elisa und Tom stehen Dir gerne bei Rückfragen zur Verfügung. Du erreichst sie unter jobs@zollsoft.de (https://mailto:jobs@zollsoft.de) . Weitere Informationen findest du auch auf unserer Website (https://zollsoft.de/jobs/) .Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
