jobs.title: Kontorelev til salg hos MyCruise
jobs.description:
Er du udadvendt, nysgerrig og motiveret af salg, mennesker og rejser?

Har du lyst til at starte din karriere i rejsebranchen og lære, hvordan man rådgiver kunder og sælger nogle af verdens mest spændende rejser?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter. MyCruise søger en kontorelev til vores salgsteam i Vanløse.

Lidt om MyCruise

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper vores kunder med at finde og sammensætte den helt rigtige rejse.

Vi har mange års erfaring med krydstogter og skræddersyede rejser og har kunder i blandt andet Danmark, Norge og Sverige.

Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed i udvikling med højt tempo, korte beslutningsveje og dygtige kolleger, der brænder for rejser, salg og gode kundeoplevelser.

Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med?

Som elev bliver du en del af vores salgsteam og får en grundig oplæring i både salg, kundedialog, krydstogter, destinationer, rederier og vores forskellige systemer.

I takt med at du bliver mere erfaren, får du mere ansvar for dine egne kunder og bookinger.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

• Rådgivning af kunder om krydstogter, rederier og destinationer

• Salg og sammensætning af individuelle krydstogtsrejser

• Behovsafdækning og hjælp til kunden med at finde den helt rigtige rejse

• Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på tilbud

• Kundekontakt på telefon og mail

• Mersalg af eksempelvis fly, hotel, transfer, forsikring og andre tillægsydelser

• Opfølgning på eksisterende kunder og nye salgsmuligheder

• Booking og administration i vores forskellige systemer

• Deltagelse på messer, kundeevents, skibsbesøg og andre arrangementer

• Løbende produkttræning og undervisning i rederier og destinationer

Du kommer altså ikke til at sidde ved siden af og kigge på. Målet er, at du under din elevtid udvikler dig til at kunne håndtere dine egne kunder og salg.

Og fordi vi er en virksomhed, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, vil der naturligvis også være praktiske og administrative opgaver undervejs.

Vi søger dig, som

• Har lyst til at arbejde med salg og motiveres af kontakten med kunder

• Interesserer dig for rejser og har lyst til at lære en helt ny branche at kende

• Er god til at tale med forskellige mennesker og tør tage telefonen og rådgive kunder

• Er serviceminded, men samtidig har et kommercielt mindset

• Er positiv, nysgerrig og har masser af gåpåmod

• Trives med mål og kan lide følelsen af at skabe et godt resultat

• Kan holde overblik, også når der er travlt

• Er struktureret og følger dine opgaver og kunder til dørs

• Er vant til IT og har nemt ved at lære nye systemer

• Taler og skriver dansk og kan kommunikere på engelsk

• Har gennemført EUX eller HHX eller en almen gymnasial uddannelse suppleret med et relevant EUS forløb med retning mod kontor

Har du allerede erfaring fra fritidsjob eller arbejde med salg, kundeservice eller kundekontakt, er det en fordel, men bestemt ikke et krav.

Resten skal vi nok lære dig.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

• En elevplads, hvor du bliver en reel del af salgsteamet fra starten

• Grundig oplæring i salg, krydstogter, rederier, destinationer og systemer

• Løn i henhold til gældende overenskomst samt pension og sundhedsordning

• Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling

• Studieture og mulighed for at opleve nogle af de produkter, vi sælger

• Personalepriser på rejser

• Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand

• En 37 timers arbejdsuge

• Kontor i Vanløse tæt på metro, bus og S tog

• En uformel arbejdsplads med engagerede kolleger og korte beslutningsveje

• En alsidig hverdag, hvor du får ansvar i takt med, at du udvikler dig

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis til  job@mycruise.dk med emnet:

Ansøgning som kontorelev i salg, DIT NAVN

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: WE ARE HIRING – 4 SKILLED CONSTRUCTION WORKERS
jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING – 4 SKILLED CONSTRUCTION WORKERS

We are currently looking for four skilled, motivated, and reliable employees to join our team. We are looking for workers with experience in carpentry, bricklaying, and demolition.

We value quality, responsibility, and teamwork. We are looking for hardworking individuals who take pride in their work, pay attention to detail, and can work both independently and as part of a team.

Positions Available

1. Carpenters

We are looking for experienced carpenters with knowledge of general carpentry, renovation, installation, woodwork, and other construction-related tasks. Candidates should be able to work independently, follow instructions, and deliver high-quality results.

2. Bricklayers

We are looking for skilled bricklayers with experience in bricklaying, masonry, plastering, renovation, and other related construction tasks. Candidates should be reliable, detail-oriented, and committed to maintaining high standards of workmanship.

3. Demolition Workers

We are looking for experienced demolition workers to assist with demolition projects, removal of building materials, site preparation, and renovation work. Candidates must be hardworking, efficient, and able to follow workplace safety procedures.

What We Expect From You

  • Experience in your respective field is an advantage.

  • You are reliable, hardworking, and responsible.

  • You can work independently and cooperate effectively with colleagues.

  • You take pride in your work and focus on quality.

  • You follow safety regulations and workplace instructions.

  • You are flexible, motivated, and willing to take on new challenges.

  • You have a positive attitude and contribute to a good working environment.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on a variety of construction projects.

  • A professional and supportive working environment.

  • Good teamwork and clear communication.

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

  • The opportunity for long-term employment and cooperation for the right candidates.

How to Apply

If you have experience in carpentry, bricklaying, or demolition and are interested in joining our team, we would be happy to hear from you.

Please send us a message introducing yourself, describing your work experience, and stating which position you are applying for. You are also welcome to include your CV, qualifications, and references from previous employers.

We are looking for dedicated workers who are ready to contribute to our projects and become valuable members of our team.

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming new employees to our team.

jobs.title: Sprichst du Deutsch und hast du Freude daran, Kindern und Jugendlichen etwas beizubringen? Dann lies weiter!
jobs.description:
Brøndbyvester Skole søger en engageret tysklærer

Er du passioneret omkring det tyske sprog, og brænder du for at skabe læringsglæde, nysgerrighed og gode relationer til elever i grundskolen? Har du lyst til at gøre tyskundervisningen levende og meningsfuld, så eleverne får mod på at bruge sproget og lyst til at lære mere? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til Brøndbyvester Skole!

Vi søger en dygtig og relationskompetent tysklærer, der har lyst til at gøre en forskel for vores elever i udskolingen. Stillingen tager som udgangspunkt afsæt i undervisning i tysk, men vi er åbne for at tilpasse stillingens omfang og indhold efter dine kompetencer, interesser og ønsker. Du kan derfor både være den rette kandidat til en deltids- eller fuldtidsstilling.

Hos os er der plads til at skabe sin egen stilling. Måske brænder du særligt for tyskfaget og den sproglige formidling, og måske har du også andre kompetencer og interesser, som kan bringes i spil i skolens hverdag. Vi vil gerne i dialog med dig om, hvordan vi sammen kan skabe en stilling, der giver mening for både dig og vores elever.

Om stillingen

  • Undervisning i tysk i udskolingen.

  • Mulighed for at præge og udvikle undervisningen med dine egne idéer og faglige interesser.

  • Mulighed for en deltids- eller fuldtidsstilling afhængigt af dine kompetencer og ønsker.

  • Mulighed for at bringe andre relevante kompetencer i spil og være med til at forme stillingens indhold.

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på faglig udvikling, stærke relationer og gode fællesskaber blandt elever og medarbejdere.

 

Vores børnesyn – alle børn skal have mulighed for at lykkes

På Brøndbyvester Skole arbejder vi ud fra et fælles børnesyn:

”Børn og unge gør det bedste, de kan, med de kompetencer, de har. Det er de voksnes ansvar at inddrage børn og unge i positive fællesskaber og læringsmiljøer med lige adgang til at udfolde og udvikle sig og trives.”

Det betyder, at vi møder børn og unge med nysgerrighed, respekt og positive forventninger. Vi tror på, at alle elever har potentiale til at udvikle sig, og at det er vores ansvar som voksne at skabe rammerne for, at de kan lykkes både fagligt, socialt og personligt.

Som lærer hos os er du med til at skabe et trygt og motiverende læringsmiljø, hvor eleverne oplever, at de bliver set, hørt og taget alvorligt. Vi ved, at børn er forskellige, og at de har brug for forskellige tilgange, udfordringer og former for støtte. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan tilpasse din undervisning og skabe plads til både forskellighed og fællesskab.

I tyskundervisningen får du mulighed for at vække elevernes nysgerrighed på sprog og kultur, skabe mod på at prøve sig frem og vise dem, at det er en del af læringen at begå fejl. Vi ønsker, at eleverne oplever tysk som et levende sprog, de kan bruge til at forstå verden omkring sig.

Vi forestiller os, at du …

  • Er læreruddannet og har erfaring med at undervise i tysk i grundskolen.

  • Brænder for formidling og kan gøre undervisningen engagerende, varieret og vedkommende.

  • Er relationskompetent og kan skabe trygge rammer, hvor eleverne tør deltage og udvikle sig.

  • Møder eleverne med anerkendelse, tydelighed og positive forventninger.

  • Kan tilpasse undervisningen til elevernes forskellige forudsætninger og behov.

  • Har lyst til at samarbejde med kolleger om elevernes faglige udvikling, trivsel og deltagelse i fællesskabet.

 

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

På Brøndbyvester Skole bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, fællesskab og trivsel går hånd i hånd. Vi prioriterer et tæt samarbejde mellem kolleger og ledelse og ønsker at skabe rammer, hvor medarbejdernes idéer, initiativer og faglige interesser kan komme til udtryk. Brøndbyvester Skole er en stor skole fordelt på to matrikler. Denne stilling er tilknyttet afdeling Tornehøj, hvor vi har elever fra 5.-9. klasse. Her bliver du en del af et læringsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, faglig udvikling og gode relationer er vigtige elementer i hverdagen. Det vigtigste er ikke, at du kan det hele fra begyndelsen, men at du har lyst til at gøre en forskel for vores elever og bidrage positivt til fællesskabet. 

Vi vil gerne skabe en stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at bringe dine styrker i spil, udvikle dine faglige interesser og få indflydelse på din hverdag. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår i dialog, og derfor er vi nysgerrige på, hvad du kan bidrage med, og hvordan vi sammen kan få dine kompetencer til at blomstre.

Praktisk information og ansøgning

  • Ansøgningsfrist: onsdag den 11. november.

  • Samtaler: Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vil du være med?

Hvis du kan se dig selv som en del af Brøndbyvester Skole, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Fortæl os gerne om din faglige baggrund, dine interesser og dine tanker om god undervisning og om, hvordan du kunne tænke dig at sætte dit præg på stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål eller vil du høre mere om mulighederne, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte skoleleder Laila Sevgi Holme på telefon 21768543.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til måske at byde dig velkommen i fællesskabet på Brøndbyvester Skole!

 

 

Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation. Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life's work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down
   
    


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you have a strong interest in the evolving AI landscape, stay closely attuned to industry trends and developments, and are curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Native or bilingual level fluency Japanese and business-level English proficiency across speaking, listening, and reading, including the ability to support team members with global communication
   
    


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.Â 

Our work changes lives. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Working here means:

  • Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better

  • High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected
  • Mission-driven teamwork: weâre passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what itâs like to work with us here:Â  politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.Â 

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firmâs financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.Â 

This role serves as the firmâs first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firmâs systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.Â 

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firmâs needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations ManagementÂ 

  • Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time.
  • Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly.
  • Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.Â Â 
  • Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.Â Â 
  • Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.Â Â 
  • Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.Â Â 
  • Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time.

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and ForecastingÂ 

  • Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time.
  • Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.Â Â 
  • Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.Â Â 
  • Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed.
  • Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.Â Â 
  • Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.Â Â 
  • Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.Â Â 
  • Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.Â Â 

Billing, Collections, and Accounts ReceivableÂ 

  • Own and continuously improve the firmâs billing and collections process.Â Â 
  • Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.Â Â 
  • Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.Â Â 
  • Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.Â Â 
  • Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.Â Â

Plaidâs network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Role Overview

You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.

You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.

Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.

  • Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaidâs entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination.

  • Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.

  • Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.

  • Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred.

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers;

  • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting;

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, APAC
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates residing in Australia or Singapore only. You can work from anywhere within those countries. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through a variety of communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

 - Deliver high-touch Enterprise support at scale, navigating complex account needs alongside Customer Success and Sales

Requirements

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

 - Currently based in Australia or Singapore.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Role summary

We're looking for a Creative Producer to help bring Linear's creative work to life. You'll work closely with Linear's internal creative studio, the Magic team, to manage projects across brand, marketing, and product launches.

In this role, you'll help keep our creative team focused and moving forward. From managing incoming requests and coordinating projects to tracking timelines and aligning stakeholders, you'll make sure great ideas turn into great work that ship on time.

 - Maintain clear project documentation, timelines, and status updates, ensuring everyone has visibility into ongoing work

 - Identify potential blockers early, resolve dependencies, and continuously improve how the creative team operates

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Role Overview

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the United States, with San Francisco or New York preferred. You can work from anywhere within the US. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

jobs.title: Data Engineer (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: The Information Lab Ireland• Salary €60,000 - €65,000• Flexible working arrangementsAbout The Information Lab: The Information Lab is a leading data and ai consultancy specialising in innovative, data-driven solutions that help organisations improve performance, strengthen decision-making and drive growth. We partner with clients across industries to harness data through analytics, AI and cloud technologies. Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design and deliver high-quality data solutions for our clients. This is a senior, hands-on position requiring a minimum of five years’ professional experience working as a Data Engineer, together with practical experience delivering solutions using Microsoft Fabric.Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the day-to-day technical execution of client projects, ensure delivery quality and coordinate small project teams. You will work directly with clients to translate business requirements into robust, scalable and well-governed data solutions. Experience with Fabric Lakehouse, Data Pipelines, Warehouses and Notebooks is required.• Strong SQL, Python and PySpark skills for data ingestion, transformation and analysis.• Experience developing end-to-end data pipelines and implementing medallion architecture.• Strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling, including Kimball standards.• Experience designing and building Power BI semantic models.• Practical experience with Git integration, version control and CI/CD pipelines for data projects.• Experience implementing data quality frameworks, reconciliation processes and testing methodologies.• Ability to produce clear solution designs, source-to-target mappings and technical documentation.• Confidence working directly with clients on requirements, technical decisions and delivery matters.• Experience reviewing technical outputs and coordinating the work of other delivery team members.• Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving and organisational skills.Desirable Experience• Experience with Databricks, Azure Synapse or other Azure data services alongside Microsoft Fabric.• Previous consulting or client-delivery experience.• Relevant Microsoft certifications, particularly DP-700 or DP-600. DP-203 is also valued.• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)• Accurate, complete and technically sound deliverables.• Delivery against agreed milestones and project commitments.• Positive client feedback on technical execution, communication and solution reliability.• Client renewal and commercial growth• High standards of code quality, governance, version control and documentation.• Effective coordination and support of project team members.• Continued development of Microsoft Fabric expertise and relevant certifications.• Contribution to pre-sales activity and identification of further value for existing clients.What we offer:• Competitive salary.• 25 days’ annual leave per year.• Pension and healthcare, subject to successful completion of the probationary period.• Dedicated learning and development days.• Flexible working arrangements.• Team-building days and a collaborative team culture.For more information, please contact careers@theinformationlab.ie

jobs.title: Join the Front of House Team at One-Michelin-Star Restaurant Udtryk
jobs.description:
Erfaren tjener søges til Michelin-restauranten Udtryk

Brænder du for klassisk værtskab, gastronomi på højeste niveau og den personlige gæsteoplevelse? Har du øje for detaljen, en stærk faglighed og lysten til at skabe oplevelser, der huskes? Så er du måske vores nye kollega på Udtryk.

Udtryk er en restaurant, hvor gastronomi, kreativitet og værtskab går hånd i hånd. Vi arbejder med en ambitiøs tastingmenu, hvor sæsonens råvarer, smagssammensætninger og æstetik er nøje gennemtænkt. Hver servering er en del af en samlet oplevelse, hvor kvaliteten ligger i detaljerne, og hvor vores gæster altid er i centrum.

Til vores dedikerede team søger vi en erfaren tjener med interesse for vin og gastronomi, som vil være med til at skabe nærværende, personlige og mindeværdige gæsteoplevelser.

Om stillingen

  • Arbejdstid: Deltid eller fuldtid med fleksibel vagtplan

  • Opstart: Efter aftale – vi venter gerne på den rette

  • Arbejdssted: København

  • Løn: Konkurrencedygtig løn baseret på erfaring og kvalifikationer

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har minimum 1-2 års erfaring som tjener – gerne fra gastronomi på højt niveau

  • Har en stærk faglighed og arbejder struktureret med sans for detaljen

  • Har interesse for vin, mad og samspillet mellem de to

  • Trives i et ambitiøst miljø med høje standarder og tæt gæstekontakt

  • Er imødekommende, ansvarsbevidst og en god kollega

  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig fagligt og bidrage aktivt til teamets fælles succes

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i et ambitiøst team med fokus på kvalitet og godt samarbejde

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling inden for gastronomi, vin og værtskab

  • Mulighed for at tage ansvar på gulvet, præsentere menu og vine samt bidrage til oplæring af nye kollegaer

  • En arbejdsplads med en flad organisation, gensidig respekt og plads til initiativ

  • Et miljø, hvor ambitioner og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd

  • Gode personalegoder, herunder fordelagtige priser på vores restauranter

Hvorfor vælge Udtryk?

På Udtryk tror vi på, at en enestående restaurantoplevelse skabes gennem samspillet mellem køkken, service og værtskab. Vi stiller høje krav til os selv, men mener samtidig, at faglig udvikling, gode kollegaer og arbejdsglæde er afgørende for at lykkes.

Hos os bliver du en del af et team, hvor detaljerne betyder noget, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab, og hvor der er plads til både ambitioner, personlighed og udvikling.

Er du klar til at tage næste skridt i din tjenerkarriere og blive en del af Udtryk?

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.


Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!


Your Team and Role

Working on the Backend Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. Using Perl (Version 5), Go, and Node.js, youâll write pragmatic, performant, testable code that works consistently, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Delivering improvements to Duck.ai to help us make it a competitive AI chat alternative for both free and paying users

  • Implementing sophisticated data processing pipelines that maintain search relevancy


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll collaborate remotely with your peers and take responsibility for solving product issues impacting our all-in-one privacy solution, whether large or small. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Backend Team at DuckDuckGo.

jobs.title: SoMe- og marketingmedarbejder
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din kreativitet til at gøre Casa Bailars hold og events synlige?

Casa Bailar er en forening og et dansehus i Roskilde med hold og events for børn, unge og voksne. Vi søger en kreativ kommunikationsmedarbejder, der kan omsætte idéer til fængende indhold, som vækker nysgerrighed, tiltrækker nye deltagere og holder medlemmerne engagerede i livet i huset.

Dine opgaver

Dine vigtigste opgaver er sociale medier og nyhedsbreve. Annoncering, hjemmesideindhold, flyers og plakater kommer i spil afhængigt af dine kompetencer og den aftalte arbejdstid.

·      Sociale medier: Planlægge, producere og publicere indhold til Facebook, Instagram og TikTok – især korte videoer og billeder. Holde kanalerne aktive og informationen korrekt og aktuel.

·      Nyhedsbreve: Lave nyhedsbreve i Mailchimp, der styrker fællesskabet, fastholder medlemmerne og fortæller om hold, sæsonstart og events.

·      Annoncering og udvikling: Bidrage til annoncering og bruge respons på indholdet og relevante tendenser til at udvikle kommunikationen.

·      Øvrigt materiale: Udarbejde hjemmesideindhold, flyers og plakater afhængigt af dine kompetencer og den aftalte arbejdstid.

Sociale medier og nyhedsbreve er dine vigtigste opgaver, og vi prioriterer sammen, så omfanget passer til dine timer. Vi vil gerne høre dine idéer - også til måder at skabe synlighed på, som vi ikke selv har tænkt på.

Det skal du kunne

·      Skabe fængende billeder og korte videoer fra idé og optagelse til redigering og publicering.

·      Tilpasse indholdet til platformen og målgruppen og formulere klare budskaber på dansk.

·      Tage initiativ og arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret og sikre kvaliteten uden at fortabe dig i detaljer.

·      Koordinere med kontoret, instruktører og eventansvarlige, så indholdet kommer ud på de rette tidspunkter.

Du er nysgerrig på dans, bevægelse og fællesskab og har lyst til at lære vores aktiviteter og målgrupper at kende. Du møder samarbejdet med godt humør og lyst til at bidrage. Vis os gerne eksempler på indhold, du har lavet.

Det er et plus, hvis du har …

·      Erfaring med sociale medier for en virksomhed eller forening.

·      Erfaring med annoncering på sociale medier og nyhedsbreve i Mailchimp.

·      Blik for andre måder at skabe synlighed og tiltrække deltagere på.

Er du stærk til organisk indhold, tilbyder vi opkvalificering inden for annoncering.

Det får du hos os

·      Kreativ indflydelse: Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på kommunikationen med kort vej fra idé til handling.

·      Introduktion og sparring: Grundig oplæring, en fast sparringspartner og gode kollegaer på kontoret.

·      Faglig udvikling: Mulighed for opkvalificering og relevante kurser.

·      Arbejdsplads og værktøjer: En arbejdsstation på kontoret, Canva Pro og mulighed for andre programmer som Photoshop eller Illustrator.

·      Fleksible arbejdstider: Indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdet inden for de aftalte rammer.

·      Personalegoder: Som sundhedsforsikring og rabat på hold og træning.

Timer, arbejdstid og ansættelsesperiode

6–12 timer om ugen med mulighed for flere timer med den rette kandidat. Vi aftaler arbejdstid og relevante skånehensyn individuelt.

Du får faste arbejdstider hos Casa Bailar. Du kan selv tage initiativ til at flytte timerne, når det giver bedre mening for opgaverne for eksempel for at filme et hold om aftenen eller et event i weekenden. Det koordinerer du med kontoret.

Stillingen løber til 31. december 2027 med god mulighed for forlængelse. Vi søger en medarbejder hurtigst muligt, så vi kan nå oplæringen inden årsskiftet.

Arbejdsstedet er Industrivej 44C, kælderen, i Roskilde. Bemærk, at der er trappeadgang uden elevator.

Interesseret?

Ring eller skriv hvis du har spørgsmål - eller send os dit CV via mail. Send også gerne eksempler på indhold, du har lavet.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Global Health at The Research Unit of General Practice, University of Southern Denmark
jobs.description:
The Research Unit of General Practice at the Institute of Public Health, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 2-year full time Assistant Professor position in Global Health. The position starts on April 1, 2027, and will terminate at the end of the appointment period unless otherwise agreed.

Beskrivelse til interne kandidater

The Research Unit of General Practice at the Institute of Public Health, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 2-year full time Assistant Professor position in Global Health.

The position starts on April 1, 2027, and will terminate at the end of the appointment period unless otherwise agreed.

Job DescriptionThe position involves research in global health with a particular focus on strengthening primary healthcare systems for vulnerable and underserved populations in low- and middle-income countries. The successful candidate will contribute to the international research project STRENGTHENing Gender-Responsive Health Systems for Addressing Non-Communicable Diseases in Climate-Affected Fishing Communities in Western Kenya (STRENGTHEN) and other upcoming global health projects. The STRENGTHEN project aims to improve the prevention and management of NCDs in climate-affected fishing communities in Western Kenya by making the health systems even more gender-responsive. The project will generate evidence on how community health promoters (CHPs) provide NCD care in FEDCs affected by climate change. It will address five key health systems building blocks: health information systems, health workforce, health service, medical technology, and policy and governance. The work will involve conducting implementation and health services research, and collaborating with researchers, healthcare professionals, policymakers, and community stakeholders across different country settings. The position involves travel to Kenya for short periods.

We offer a challenging position in a stimulating research environment with excellent opportunities for collaboration within SDU and with international research partners.

Expectations of qualificationsThe successful applicant should have:

  • A PhD degree (or equivalent) in Global Health, Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Services Research, Implementation Science, or a related discipline

  • A strong background in health systems research, primary healthcare, chronic disease prevention and management, or health equity research in low- and middle-income countries

  • A strong academic record

  • Good collaboration and communication skills

  • Interest in co-supervising BSc, MSc and PhD students

Following qualifications are preferred:

  • Experience with mixed-methods research, including qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis

  • Experience with implementation science, intervention development, and evaluation of community-based health programmes

  • Experience with global health research conducted in low- and middle-income countries and/or humanitarian settings

  • Experience with stakeholder engagement and collaboration with healthcare providers, communities, and policymakers

  • Experience with writing research applications

  • Experience in teaching and education

Further informationFor further information please contact Prof. Jens Søndergaard, jsondergaard@health.sdu.dk, or Associate Prof. Trine Thilsing, tthilsing@health.sdu.dk 

Application deadline and interviewsThe application deadline is November15th 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  

Terms of employment Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from 1. April 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme, if this has not already been completed.   

Appointment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level. 

Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. 

The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations .

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.  

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Application Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.  

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.  

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.  

Your application must include the following as PDF files: 

Please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total). 

  • a motivation letter.  

  • a detailed CV.  

  • degree certificates (including a Ph.D.-diploma). 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications.  

  • 3 to 5 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.  

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy.  

  • a research plan an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position. 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Assessment and selection process Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

About UsThe Research Unit of General Practice is a collaboration between the Research Unit of General Practice in Odense-Esbjerg, which is organizationally affiliated with the Foundation for General Practice Research (FEA), and the Research Unit of General Practice at the Department of Public Health, University of Southern Denmark (SDU).

The primary objective of the Research Unit is to contribute to the improvement and development of health and healthcare for patients, with a particular focus on services provided in and around general practice. 

A cornerstone of our educational activities is the training of Master's and PhD students. In addition, we contribute to teaching across a range of health sciences bachelor's and master's degree programmes at the Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, as well as within the Research Training Programme of the specialist training programme in general practice.

Further information about The Faculty of Health Sciences. 

Living and working in DenmarkForeign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Vi søger motiverede og engagerede elektrikere til større byggesager eller serviceopgaver.

Hvem er du?

Du ved, du er en dygtig Elektriker, som sætter pris på at udføre et godt stykke arbejde.

  • Du har en positiv tilgang til dine medmennesker.

Hvem er vi

Vores opgaver udføres hovedsageligt i Storkøbenhavn, København og  Nordsjælland.

Du vil blive en del at et team af dedikerede medarbejdere med godt sammenhold, firmaklub, udflugter og fester.

Hvis du kan se dig selv hos os, hører vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

For yderligere information ring 49700624 og spørg efter Thomas Vindahl Andersen eller  Christian Wegener.

Vi ansætter så snart rette person er fundet, så vent ikke!

Om FVA

FVA er en velkonsolideret virksomhed, stiftet i 1961 af Finn Vindahl Andersen. Finns søn, Thomas Vindahl Andersen, overtog ledelsen i 2010.

Virksomheden er i udvikling og dækker alle væsentlige områder inden for bygningsinstallation, hvilket betyder, at vi i dag kan tilbyde knowhow, kompetence og service inden for VVS, blikkenslagerarbejde, elinstallation, kloak samt ventilation.

Virksomheden har base i Hornbæk, som også vil være dit arbejdssted, og dækker hele Helsingør, Nordsjælland, København og Storkøbenhavn.

Både opkøb og organisk vækst har bidraget til at virksomheden er i kraftig vækst.

Vores vision er at være kundens komplette teknik-entreprenør, som kan løse samtlige opgaver inden for tekniske installationer i bygge- og anlægssektoren.

jobs.title: IT Problem and Incident Manager – Turn Problems into Progress

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark—helping ensure the efficient operation of the Nordic power system and a high level of security of supply.

At Nordic RCC, stable and reliable services are critical. We're looking for a Problem and Incident Manager who thrives on finding the root cause, solving recurring issues, and driving continuous improvement.

  • Identify trends and drive preventive improvements.

  • Coordinate resolution efforts across teams and suppliers.

  • Support major incidents and ensure lessons learned become actions.

  • Help improve service reliability and operational excellence.

What we're looking for:

  • Experience in Problem, Incident, Service, or IT Operations Management.

  • Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.

You'll play a key role in supporting the critical infrastructure that powers the Nordic energy market while working with skilled colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

jobs.title: Automotive Technician
jobs.description:
2 positions · Troubleshooting · Test setups · New components · R&D

Do you enjoy figuring out why something does not work? RENTEQ Automotive is looking for two technicians who want to troubleshoot electric vehicles and machines, set up test setups and take part when we develop and test new components. You do not need many years of experience. What matters most is that you are hands on, curious and eager to learn.

About RENTEQ

RENTEQ Automotive is a Danish company at the forefront of electrifying existing diesel machines and vehicles. We develop and produce conversion kits for authorised dealers and end customers, and we work with everything from vans to heavy off highway machines such as dumpers and excavators. We are a growing startup with short decision paths, and our workshop and offices under one roof in Dragør.

The job

You will join our technical team in R&D and work closely with engineers, software developers and mechanics. You will be where things are tested and tried out in practice. One day you are troubleshooting a van, the next you are helping build a test setup for a new component. The work is mainly based in Dragør, but tasks at other locations may occasionally come up.

Your tasks will include:

•       Troubleshoot electrical systems and wiring harnesses on vehicles and machines

•       Set up and maintain test setups, both on the bench and in the vehicles

•       Help test new components and get them installed and integrated

•       Use diagnostic tools and CAN logs to find faults

•       Support engineers and software developers with the hands on work during testing

•       Document faults, solutions and test results so the rest of the team can use them.

Is this you?

You may be newly qualified or have a few years of experience from a workshop or similar. We care more about your troubleshooting skills and willingness to learn than about how long you have been in the trade.

•       Trained as a car mechanic, mechatronics technician, truck mechanic, construction machinery mechanic, electrician or similar

•       Experience with electrical troubleshooting on vehicles or machines

•       Comfortable using a multimeter and diagnostic equipment

•       Hands on, systematic and good at keeping things organised

•       Curious and quick to learn new things

•       Good English skills, Danish is an advantage

It is a plus if you know some of the following, but it is not a requirement:

•       CAN bus and tools such as PCAN, SavvyCAN or similar

•       Electric or hybrid vehicles, or high voltage systems

•       A driving licence for larger vehicles.

What we offer

•       A varied job on many different vehicles and machines

•       The chance to learn a lot about electric vehicles, CAN and high voltage

•       Close collaboration with engineers and software developers, where asking questions and helping each other comes naturally

•       Access to test equipment and modern diagnostic tools

•       An informal team in a growing startup

•       Good facilities, shared lunch and easy access by car or public transport.

Salary

Salary is set individually based on gender neutral criteria: education, work experience and other qualifications. We are happy to share the salary range for your profile before the first interview.

Practical information

•       Number of positions: 2

•       Employment: Permanent, full time

•       Department: R&D

•       Location: Mainly on site in Dragør, with some flexibility by agreement

•       Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines about yourself and your troubleshooting experience to louie@ren-teq.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Louie Lucas Bisgaard Nyeland at louie@ren-teq.com or +45 27812385.

 

RENTEQ Automotive · Dragør, Denmark · www.ren-teq.com

  2. Du kommer tæt på de borgere, vi hjælper. Med din faglige ekspertise og omsorg kan du gøre en mærkbar forskel i deres liv. Sammen med borgerne finder du løsninger, der passer til deres individuelle behov og ønsker.

  3. Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab med kollegaer, der brænder for omsorg og nærvær. Vi støtter hinanden, sparrer om udfordringer og fejrer de succeser, vi skaber sammen. For os er samarbejde nøglen til at lykkes – hver dag.

  4. En fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor vi forstår, at livet skal hænge sammen. Har du brug for en løsning, der matcher din hverdag, finder vi ud af det sammen. Vores værdier er initiativ, omtanke, fællesskab og nr. 1 i service – det gør os til en arbejdsplads, der tager hensyn til dig som menneske.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver:

  1. Omsorg og praktisk hjælp i borgernes hjem

  2. Du spiller en central rolle i borgernes hverdag ved at levere omsorg og støtte med praktiske opgaver inden for rengøring og tøjvask , som gør en reel forskel for deres livskvalitet. Du sørger for, at den rette hjælp gives til rette tid, så borgerne føler sig trygge og godt tilpas i deres eget hjem. Dette praktisk hjælp og nærværende samtaler. Din gode kommunikationsevne og empati gør dig til en afgørende støtte for borgern

Der er Køretid mellem borgerne En del af din arbejdsdag vil inkludere transport mellem borgernes hjem. Vi giver dig de nødvendige ressourcer og værktøjer, så du kan koncentrere dig om det vigtigste – at gøre en forskel for borgerne. Du skal have gyldigt kørekort, og kunne stille egen bil til rådighed.

  3. Hos Carelink Pleje er vores mission klar: "Vi skaber rammerne for livskvalitet og et værdigt liv" – og vi søger en medarbejder, der brænder for at bidrage til dette hver dag.

jobs.title: Battery Technology Lead
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about battery technology? RENTEQ Automotive is looking for someone to lead our testing of battery cells and modules, and to make us ready to switch quickly when new battery technologies reach the market. Many years of experience is not the most important thing. What matters most is that you have a solid background in battery technology, from either work or studies.

About RENTEQ

RENTEQ Automotive is a Danish company at the forefront of electrifying existing diesel machines and vehicles. We develop and produce conversion kits for authorised dealers and end customers, and we work with everything from vans to heavy off highway machines. We are a growing startup with short decision paths and high professional ambitions.

The job

Batteries are at the core of our products, and the technology is moving fast. You will have the main responsibility for our battery testing and for making us ready for new cell types, formats and suppliers. You will also be an important technical voice when we decide how batteries are used in our systems. You will be part of R&D and work closely with our engineers.

Your tasks will include:

•       Plan and carry out tests of battery cells and modules, such as capacity, cycle testing, performance and thermal behaviour

•       Build test setups and processes so we can quickly evaluate and adopt new battery technologies

•       Help select and purchase test equipment and tools

•       Document test results and turn them into clear recommendations

•       Be a technical sparring partner on cell selection and integration into our systems

•       Keep yourself and the team up to date on developments in battery technology

•       Act as the technical link in the design of battery enclosures

•       Communicate with external test facilities when needed.

Is this you?

Your background can come from industry or from your studies. You may be a recent graduate with a strong theoretical foundation, or have hands on experience with battery systems. Both profiles are interesting to us.

•       Background in battery technology, electrochemistry, energy engineering or similar

•       Knowledge of testing battery cells or modules

•       Understanding of safe battery handling

•       Interest in test equipment and test methods

•       Structured and thorough in your documentation

•       Good at explaining technical topics so both engineers and other colleagues understand them

•       Good English skills, Danish is an advantage.

What we offer

•       Main responsibility for an area that is central to our products

•       The opportunity to build our battery testing from the ground up

•       Influence on technology choices and equipment purchases

•       Close collaboration with dedicated engineers in an informal environment

•       Good facilities in Dragør with easy access by car or public transport.

 Salary

Salary is set individually based on gender neutral criteria: education, work experience and other qualifications. We are happy to share the salary range for your profile before the first interview.

Practical information

•       Employment: Permanent, full time

•       Department: R&D

•       Location: Mainly on site in Dragør, with some flexibility by agreement

•       Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines about your background in battery technology to louie@ren-teq.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Louie Lucas Bisgaard Nyeland at louie@ren-teq.com or +45 27812385.

 

RENTEQ Automotive · Dragør, Denmark · www.ren-teq.com

jobs.title: Automotive Software Engineer
jobs.description:
2 positions · Electric vehicles · Broad profile · R&D

Do you want to help create software that runs in real vehicles in your very first week? RENTEQ Automotive is looking for two software people who are curious, learn fast and want to try their hand at a bit of everything. You do not need to be a specialist or have many years of experience. What matters most is that you are adaptable and eager to learn.

About RENTEQ

RENTEQ Automotive is a Danish company at the forefront of electrifying existing diesel machines and vehicles. We convert everything from vans to dumpers and excavators, and all the vehicles run on control software we develop ourselves. We are a growing startup with short decision paths, a small team, and our workshop and offices under one roof in Dragør.

What is it like to work with us?

Our software developers are never far from the product. The workshop is right next door, and the changes you make in the morning can be tested in a vehicle in the afternoon. We are a small team where everyone helps each other, and you will quickly work closely with engineers, mechanics and management.

We do not expect you to know everything from day one. You will get time to learn our system, and support from colleagues working with CAN, embedded software, high voltage and testing. In return, we expect you to be curious, ask questions and be keen to get stuck in.

The job

You will start by getting to know our system: how the vehicles are controlled, how the software is structured, and how it all ties together with CAN and hardware. After that, you will become part of the daily software work and help develop the system further. Our control software is currently built in Simulink, and we are moving parts of it to C/C++, so you will work with both.

Your tasks will include:

•       Get to know our control software and how it works together with the vehicle

•       Flash and test software on the bench and in the vehicles

•       Test new components and help integrate them into the system

•       Debug using CAN logs and measurement data

•       Help develop new features and improve existing ones

•       Document what you learn and build so the rest of the team can use it too.

Is this you?

We are looking for broad profiles rather than specialists. You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of experience. What matters most is that you have a good foundation and a desire to learn.

•       A degree in software, electronics, mechatronics, automation or similar, or equivalent experience

•       Programming experience, for example C, C++, Python or Matlab

•       Curious, adaptable and quick to learn new things

•       You enjoy hands on work and seeing things work in real life

•       Good English skills, Danish is an advantage

It is a plus if you have tried some of the following, but it is not a requirement:

•       Simulink or Stateflow

•       Embedded software or microcontrollers

•       CAN bus and tools such as PCAN or Vector

•       Electric vehicles, batteries or high voltage systems

•       Git.

What we offer

•       A job where you see your software running in real vehicles on the road and on construction sites

•       A fast-paced professional development opportunity with broad insight into software, hardware and electric vehicles

•       A small, informal team where asking questions and helping each other comes naturally

•       Varied tasks on many different vehicles and machines

•       The opportunity to grow with the company and shape how we build our software going forward

•       Workshop and offices in Dragør with easy access by car or public transport.

Salary

Salary is set individually based on gender neutral criteria: education, work experience and other qualifications. We are happy to share the salary range for your profile before the first interview.

Practical information

•       Number of positions: 2

•       Employment: Permanent, full time

•       Department: R&D

•       Location: On site in Dragør

•       Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines about yourself to louie@ren-teq.com. Feel free to tell us about a project you have worked on, ideally something you built in your spare time or during your studies. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Louie Lucas Bisgaard Nyeland at louie@ren-teq.com or +45 27812385.

RENTEQ Automotive · Dragør, Denmark · www.ren-teq.com

jobs.title: Sælger til trælast og byggecenter
jobs.description:
Er du en dygtig sælger, der tager ansvar, ser muligheder og selv får tingene til at ske?

Vi søger en ny kollega til Mou Trælast & Byggecenter. Vi har brug for dig, der trives med kundekontakt og salg, men som også tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og er med til at få butikken til at fungere i hverdagen.

Hos os får du ansvar for egne produktområder. Det betyder, at du ikke bare skal sælge varerne, men også holde øje med sortimentet, sørge for vareopfyldning og tage initiativ, når noget kan gøres bedre.

Du behøver ikke kende hele vores sortiment fra starten. Erfaring fra trælast, byggemarked, detailhandel eller håndværk er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling, kan arbejde selvstændigt og har lyst til at lære.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af et mindre hold, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, og hvor alle tager del i den daglige drift.

Hverdagen er varieret. Den ene kunde er en professionel håndværker, der skal hurtigt videre. Den næste er en privatkunde, som har brug for hjælp til at finde den rigtige løsning.

Samtidig skal varer bestilles, hylder fyldes op, og butikken holdes salgsklar.

Dine opgaver bliver bl.a. at:

  • sælge og rådgive både private og professionelle kunder

  • tage ansvar for dine egne produktområder

  • disponere varer og holde styr på sortiment og lager

  • sørge for vareopfyldning og en ordentlig varepræsentation

  • se muligheder for at udvikle salget og forbedre dine områder

  • tage del i de praktiske opgaver i butikken

Du får frihed til at løse dine opgaver, men vi forventer også, at du selv følger dem til dørs.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med salg og kundebetjening og trives med at have ansvar.

Du er typen, der selv tager fat, når du ser noget, der skal gøres. Du har overblik over dine opgaver, kan prioritere i en travl hverdag og har det godt med, at arbejdsdagen ikke altid går helt som planlagt.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • er serviceminded og har flair for salg

  • arbejder selvstændigt og tager initiativ

  • tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og følger dem til dørs

  • har praktisk sans og kan lide en alsidig arbejdsdag

  • kan holde overblik over sortiment, varer og egne ansvarsområder

  • fungerer godt i et mindre team, hvor alle hjælper hinanden

Har du kendskab til byggematerialer, værktøj eller håndværk, er det en fordel. Men du kan også komme med erfaring fra en anden branche.

Vi hjælper dig med at lære produkterne og vores arbejdsgange at kende. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig, engageret og klar til at tage ansvar.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Mou Trælast & Byggecenter er en del af en lokal, familieejet virksomhed med historie tilbage til 1909.

Hos os bliver du en del af et mindre hold, hvor din indsats kan mærkes. Vi har en uformel omgangstone, hjælper hinanden og har korte beslutningsveje.

Du får dine egne ansvarsområder og mulighed for at præge både sortimentet, varepræsentationen og den daglige drift.

  • en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

  • grundig oplæring i produkter og arbejdsgange

  • selvstændigt ansvar og indflydelse på din arbejdsdag

  • mulighed for faglig udvikling

  • gode kolleger og et uformelt arbejdsmiljø

Skal du være vores nye kollega?

Arbejdssted:Mou Trælast & ByggecenterVester Fjordvej 4-69280 Storvorde

Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugenTiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt
